Misc.No.704/40.     Bubbling Well
                    22nd. October-      40.
1.

INCIDENT INVOLVING BRITISH SUBJECT AT
JAPANESE GENDARMERIE ERECTED BARRIER
ON BUBBLING WELL ROAD.
======================================

At 1.50 p.m. October 22, 1940, Mr. J.S. Sifton,
(Lieut. of S.V.C. in "B" Sector), Chief Accountant of
the Shanghai Gas Co. Ltd., with residence at 18, Lane
42 Tunsin Road, came to Bubbling Well Station and
requested advice regarding an incident at a "Knife-
rest" barrier erected by the Japanese Gendarmerie on
Bubbling Well Road just West of Tifeng Road, in
connection with murder of a member of that force on
18-10-40.

Mr. Sifton states that he was proceeding home
alone in his car, licence No.2169, holding Driving
Permit No.3391, at about 12 midnight October 21st.
On reaching a barrier erected across Bubbling Well
Road West of Tifeng Road he noticed that the gap was
too narrow to allow his car through. Not seeing any
police or military about he alighted from his car and
proceeded to open the barrier a little, however the
knife-rest not being securely connected collapsed,
whereupon from ten to twelve members of the Shanghai
City Government Police dashed up from cover with drawn
pistols to enquire what he was doing. Later two
members of the Japanese Gendarmerie came on the scene,

                    1940年10月22日
1.

英国臣民在静安寺路日本宪兵队设立的路障处涉及的事件。
======================================

1940年10月22日下午1时50分，上海煤气有限公司首席会计师、住址为铜仁路42弄18号的J.S. Sifton先生（“B”区上海义勇军 lieutenant），来到静安寺路捕房，就1940年10月18日该部队一名成员被谋杀后，日本宪兵队在静安寺路提丰路（音译）以西设立的“拒马”路障处发生的一起事件寻求建议。

Sifton先生称，10月21日午夜12时许，他独自驾驶牌照号为2169的汽车回家，持有驾照号3391。当到达提丰路以西横跨静安寺路设置的路障时，他注意到间隙太窄，无法让他的汽车通过。由于未见周围有警察或军人，他下车试图稍微移开路障，然而因拒马连接不牢固而倒塌，随即十至十二名上海市政府警察从隐蔽处冲出，拔出手枪询问他在做什么。随后两名日本宪兵来到现场，

1. (Sheet 2)

one of whom in English demanded Mr. Sifton's Driving
Permit which he at once produced. The Gendarmerie
took down particulars and instructed Mr. Sifton to
report at their office - no address stated - in the
morning 22nd. at, what Mr. Sifton believes to have
been, 10 a.m. Mr. Sifton was then given back his
Permit and allowed to proceed home after which he
decided not to take any further notice.

However, at about 1.40 p.m. 22nd. prior to leaving
his home for office, he received a telephone call from
the Japanese Gendarmerie enquiring why he had not
visited 94 Jessfield Road at 8 a.m. as promised. Mr.
Sifton replied that he was busy and could not go. The
Gendarmerie speaker then said they would expect Mr.
Sifton soon.

Mr. Sifton reported at Bubbling Well Station and
informed Chief Inspector West and the undersigned that
he did not think he could visit 94 Jessfield Road in
S.V.C. uniform as he was due on "B" Sector duty at
6 p.m. for twenty-four hours.

During this interview Mrs. Sifton telephoned from
18/42 Tonsin Road to the effect that she had had three
calls from the Japanese Gendarmerie between 2 and 2.30
p.m.
page_data.zh:
杂项编号704/40 (B?)

1. (第2页)

其中一人用英语要求Sifton先生出示驾照，他立即出示。宪兵记录下详细信息，并指示Sifton先生于次日上午（Sifton先生认为是上午10时）前往他们的办公室报到——未说明地址。随后Sifton先生取回驾照并被允许回家，此后他决定不再理会此事。

然而，10月22日下午1时40分左右，在他离家去办公室之前，他接到日本宪兵队的电话，询问他为何未按承诺于上午8时前往极司菲尔路94号。Sifton先生回答说他很忙，不能去。宪兵队通话人随后表示他们很快会期待Sifton先生到来。

Sifton先生向静安寺路捕房报告，并告知韦斯特总督察和下文签署人，他认为他不能穿着上海义勇军制服前往极司菲尔路94号，因为他将于下午6时开始担任“B”区勤务，为期二十四小时。

在此次面谈期间，Sifton夫人从铜仁路42弄18号打来电话，称她在下午2时至2时30分之间接到了日本宪兵队的三次电话。

page_data.en:
Misc.No.704/40(Bw)

1 (Sheet 3)

Inspector Yamaguchi was given details of the
incident. He telephoned 94 Jessfield Road and
ascertained that as Mr. Sifton had promised to
report there this morning they were expecting him
and that it was just a matter of a few questions
to clear up the incident.

In view of this Mr. Sifton decided to accompany
Inspector Yamaguchi to 94 Jessfield Road at 2.45 p.m.
Mr. Sifton was interviewed by Sergeant Major Yamaguchi
of the Gendarmerie when he apologised for his failure
to recognise the knife-rest barrier of a Military
Post.

Mr. Sifton and Inspector Yamaguchi returned to
Bubbling Well Station at 4 p.m. and reported the
incident closed.

Det. Inspector

D.D.O. "B" Div.
D.C. Special Branch.
D.C. Divisions.
page_data.zh:
杂项编号704/40(Bw)

1 (第3页)

山口督察获悉了事件详情。他致电极司菲尔路94号，查明由于Sifton先生承诺今早去那里报到，他们正在等他，这只是为了澄清事件而问几个问题而已。

鉴于此，Sifton先生决定于下午2时45分陪同山口督察前往极司菲尔路94号。Sifton先生接受了宪兵队山口中士长的问询，期间他为自己未能识别军事哨所的拒马路障而道歉。

Sifton先生和山口督察于下午4时返回静安寺路捕房，并报告事件已结案。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
Sp. Br. REGISTRY
442 (C)
December 30, 1940.

Western District Situation

The barbed wire barricades are still in place
to-day, December 30, 1940, at various locations in
the Western District as already related in the previous
reports.

At 10 a.m. December 29, 1940, Messrs Chu Zung
Ling (朱顺林) and Yu Nyoh Ching (余玉卿), Chairman
and standing committee member respectively of the "Zao
Ka Doo Branch of the Western District Citizens' Association",
10 Ting Nyieh Li, Brenan Road, O.O.L. and representing
the citizens of the Zao Ka Doo District, called upon Major
Fujino (藤野) of the Western District Japanese Military
Police, 94 Jessfield Road, O.O.L. with a request for the
removal of the barricades. Due consideration is said to
have been promised by the Major. It is rumoured that an
attempt has been made to bribe the Major with a sum of
$20,000 but he refused because the amount was too small.

1940年12月30日。

西区局势

正如先前报告所述，截至1940年12月30日今天，西区的各个地点仍设有铁丝网路障。

1940年12月29日上午10时，住于越界筑路区布伦南路廷业里10号的“西区公民协会曹家渡分会”主席朱顺林和常务委员余玉卿，代表曹家渡区市民，拜访了位于越界筑路区极司菲尔路94号的西区日本宪兵队藤野少佐，请求拆除路障。据说少佐答应予以慎重考虑。有谣言称，有人试图向少佐行贿20,000元，但因金额太少而被拒绝。

page_data.en:
C O P Y

December 23, 1940.

Situation in Western District.

The barbed wire entanglements erected by
the City Government Police at the following points
on December 18, have not yet been removed:-
(1) Brenan Piece and Robison Road corner.
(2) Brenan Piece and Brenan Road.
(3) Corner of Brenan Piece and Jessfield
Road Extension.
(4) Brenan Piece and Jessfield Road corner.
(5) Jessfield-Brenan Roads corner.
(6) Outside Shing Kong Li, off Connaught Road.
(7) Outside Shing Kong Li, off Jessfield Road.

Because of this barricade, business in the
barricated area has been affected considerably,
according to information obtained from the traders
in the District, and at the latter's request, the
Zao Ka Doo Branch of the Western District Citizens'
Association, 10 Ting Nyieh Li, Brenan Road, O.O.L.
is now soliciting the assistance of Mr. Pan San Sing,
Chairman of the Western District Citizens' Association,
Lane 126, A23 Kinnear Road, to conduct negotiations
with the authorities concerned for the removal of same.

据从该区商人处获得的信息，由于此路障，路障区域内的商业受到严重影响，应商人们的要求，位于越界筑路区布伦南路廷业里10号的西区公民协会曹家渡分会现正请求位于金尼尔路A23号126弄的西区公民协会主席潘三兴（音译）先生协助，与有关当局进行谈判以拆除路障。

page_data.en:
December 16, 1940.

Assassination of Japanese Military Police.

The restrictions enforced by the Japanese
authorities in the area between Great Western Road
and Yu Yuen Road following the fatal wounding of
a member of the Japanese Gendarmerie, was lifted
on December 14, but those passing through Waung
Ka Loong (江家弄) off Great Western Road and
Chu An Pang (諸安浜) off Edinburgh Road, are
still subject to search by the City Government
Police and Japanese Gendarmerie. The public rickshas
specially permitted to pass on orders from the
Western District Communications Committee continue
to ply for hire in the area south of Yu Yuen Road,
along Edinburgh Road and its vicinity. The Western
District Residents' Buses ceased operating following
the lifting of the restrictions, and the vehicles are
now parked outside the "Bus Company", Lane 126,
A-23 Kinnear Road.
page_data.zh:
1940年12月16日。

日本宪兵遇刺案。

继一名日本宪兵受致命伤后，日本当局在大西路与愚园路之间区域实施的管制已于12月14日解除，但经过大西路旁汪家弄（原文此处为Waung Ka Loong，括号内中文为江家弄，后文p18修正为汪家弄，此处依原文括号翻译）和爱丁堡路旁诸安浜的人员，仍须接受市政府警察和日本宪兵队的搜查。经西区交通委员会特别许可通行的公共黄包车，继续在愚园路以南、沿爱丁堡路及其附近区域载客营运。西区居民巴士在管制解除后停止运营，车辆现停放在金尼尔路A-23号126弄“巴士公司”外。

December 13, 1940.

Assassination of Japanese Military Police
..........

The restrictions enforced by the Japanese
authorities in the area between Great Western
Road and Yu Yuen Road following the fatal wounding
of a member of the Japanese Gendarmerie, continues.
Chinese pedestrians are still being searched while
passing through the area.

The Western District Residents' Buses continue
to run a service along the two routes between Tifeng
Road and Jessfield Park, and between Bubbling Well
and Great Western-Columbia Road corner. Instead
of desks, ticket sales boxes have been established
at each exit of the barricaded areas immediately
inside the barricades, which the "new buses" pass
through.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL / 17 DEC. 1940 / COMMISSIONER）

In addition to the "bus services", some 100
public rickshas which have been licensed by the City
Government authorities but without Settlement licences,
are plying for hire inside the barricaded area. Each
ricksha has affixed to the back of the ricksha a small
piece of white paper bearing the following Chinese
inscriptions : "Specially permitted to pass: Western
District Communications Committee" (西交通委員
會特准通行) and chopped by the same. This
serves as a special "licence" for which ricksha owners
are required to pay $2.00 each. The so-called

Commr of Police.

SE
1940年12月13日。

日本宪兵遇刺案
..........

继一名日本宪兵受致命伤后，日本当局在大西路与愚园路之间区域实施的管制仍在继续。中国行人经过该区域时仍受到搜查。

西区居民巴士继续在这两条线路上提供服务：一条在提丰路和极司菲尔公园之间，另一条在静安寺路和大西路-哥伦比亚路转角之间。除了办公桌外，在路障区域内紧靠路障内侧的每个出口处都设立了售票箱，“新巴士”从中穿过。
（印章：上海公共租界工部局 / 1940年12月17日 / 总监）

除了“巴士服务”外，约有100辆已获得市政府当局许可但未获租界执照的公共黄包车，在路障区域内载客营运。每辆黄包车的背面都贴有一张小白纸，上面印有以下中文：“西交通委员会特准通行”，并盖有该委员会的印章。这作为一种特殊的“执照”，黄包车车主需为此每人支付2.00元。所谓的

警务总监。
先生：
情报
（签名）
A. C. (特别处)
113

- 2 -

"Western District Communications Committee" is
known to have been formed by the Traffic Control
Office of the Bureau of Public Utilities at 92
Jessfield Road, O.O.L.

To prevent Settlement licensed rickshas from
entering the extra-Settlement roads area, barbed
wire barricades have been erected at Connaught Road
near Yenping Road and outside Ying Hwa Li, off
Robinson Road, in addition to barbed wire entanglement
at Jessfield-Avenue Roads corner.

A patrol party consisting of eight Japanese
Military Police was seen patrolling Jessfield Road,
Connaught Road and Robison Road, this morning,
December 13.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

“西区交通委员会”据知是由位于越界筑路区极司菲尔路92号的公用局交通管制处成立的。

为防止持有租界执照的黄包车进入越界筑路区域，除了在极司菲尔路-爱文义路转角处的铁丝网障碍外，还在康纳脱路靠近延平路处以及罗宾逊路外的英华里外设置了铁丝网路障。

12月13日上午，有人看到一支由八名日本宪兵组成的巡逻队在极司菲尔路、康纳脱路和罗宾逊路巡逻。

December 12, 1940.

Assassination of Japanese Military Police.
------------------

The restrictions enforced by the Japanese
Authorities in the area between Great Western Road
and Yu Yuen Road following the fatal wounding of
a member of the Japanese Gendarmerie, continues.
A number of houses and huts in Waung Ka
Loong (Lane 52), Great Western Road are being
demolished by order of the Chinese Police,

built through the space left by the demolition of

December 10, 1940.

Assassination of Japanese Military Police.

The restrictions enforced by the Japanese
authorities in the area between Great Western Road
and Yu Yuen Road following the fatal wounding of a
member of the Japanese Gendarmerie, continues.
Chinese are allowed to pass through the exits by
the Japanese authorities but are still subject to
search.

According to information obtained, the
Western District Citizens' Association, Lane 126,
A-23 Kinnear Road, has received instructions from
the Japanese Military Police to the effect that all
shops and residents in the extra-Settlement roads
area should be ordered to join the association, and
furnish guarantees during registration. Those
ignoring the instructions and who are found to be
undesirable characters will be dealt with.

This step appears to have been devised in
order to assist in the re-census and to check
unruly elements. In view of the abnormal situation
and different elements among the residents in the
Western District, O.O.L., the branches of the Western
District Citizens' Association have not put the
orders into execution, despite the fact that they
have been instructed to do so. They have applied
to Pan San Sing (潘三省), Chairman of the Western
District Citizens' Association for detailed procedure
in dealing with the registration.

（左侧手写批注：Sd CG）

1940年12月10日。

日本宪兵遇刺案。

继一名日本宪兵队员受致命伤后，日本当局在大西路（Great Western Road）与愚园路（Yu Yuen Road）之间区域实施的管制措施仍在继续。中国人经日本当局允许可通过出口，但仍须接受搜查。

据所得情报，西区市民协会（地址：金尼尔路 A-23号 126弄）已收到日本宪兵队的指示，大意是命令越界筑路区域内的所有商店和居民加入该协会，并在登记时提供担保。那些无视指示且被发现为不良分子者将受到处置。

此举似乎旨在协助重新进行人口普查并管控不安定分子。鉴于西区（O.O.L.，即越界筑路区）居民情况异常且成分复杂，西区市民协会各分会虽已接到执行命令的指示，但并未付诸实施。他们已向西区市民协会主席潘三省申请有关处理登记事宜的详细程序。

page_data.en:
SECRET
December 7, 1940.

Assassination of Japanese Military Police.

The restrictions enforced by the Japanese
authorities in the area between Great Western Road
and Yu Yuen Road following the fatal wounding of a
member of the Japanese Gendarmerie, continues, and
the situation remains practically same as yesterday.
With regard to the new buses running in the
barricaded area, it is known that a company entitled
the "Western District Residents' Omnibus Company"
(沪西市民公共汽車公司) has been established with an office
at Lane 126, A.23 Kinnear Road. The manager is
Pan San Sing (潘三省), Chairman of the Western
District Citizens' Association, which is located at
the same address, and endeavours are being made by
Pan to solicit a total capital of $300,000.00 for the
enterprise. In addition to the three buses which
have been put into use, another bus is running
between Bubbling Well and Great Western-Columbia
Road corner. According to information, another
route will be started from the Company's office at
Lane 126, 23 Kinnear Road via Jessfield Road, Brenan
Piece, to Jessfield Park and return through Yu Yuen
Road, Jessfield Road, to the starting point.
Altogether some 12 conductors have been employed,
each being paid $2.00 a day.

继一名日本宪兵队员受致命伤后，日本当局在大西路（Great Western Road）与愚园路（Yu Yuen Road）之间区域实施的管制措施仍在继续，局势与昨日基本相同。关于在封锁区域内运行的新式公共汽车，据悉一家名为“沪西市民公共汽車公司”的公司已成立，办事处设在金尼尔路 A.23号 126弄。经理为西区市民协会主席潘三省，该协会亦位于同一地址，潘正努力为该事业募集总额30万美元的资本。除了已投入使用的三辆公共汽车外，另有一辆公共汽车在静安寺与大西路-哥伦比亚路转角之间运行。据情报，另一条路线将从该公司办事处（金尼尔路23号126弄）出发，经由极司菲尔路（Jessfield Road）、白利南路（Brenan Piece，音译，现长宁路部分路段）至兆丰公园（Jessfield Park），再经愚园路、极司菲尔路返回起点。总共雇佣了约12名售票员，每人每日薪金2.00美元。

CONFIDENTIAL
DRAWER

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
December 5, 1940. REGISTRY
No. 11422 (C)

Assassination of Japanese Military Police

The restrictions enforced by the Japanese
authorities in the area between Great Western Road and
Lu Yuen Road following the fatal wounding of a member of
the Japanese Gendarmerie, continues but the situation
appears to have improved slightly. Passage is now
allowed by three routes, the corner of Great Western-
Edinburgh Roads; Yu Yuen-Edinburgh Roads and Lane 668,
Yu Yuen Road; but Chinese passengers and private motor
cars passing these points are subject to search.

Arrangements have been made by the China Club,
a gambling den situated at 29 Tifeng Road, that only
vehicles belonging the Silver Taxi Company will be permitted
to pass through the barricaded area.

During the afternoon of December 5, buses which
are said to have been brought from North of the Creek,
made their appearance in the Western District. They are
similar in size to the buses previously used in Nantao
before the outbreak of the hostilities. Two buses run
between Tifeng Road and Jessfield Park, and one between
Bubbling Well and Great Western-Columbia Road corner.
The former commenced operation at 3 p.m., while the latter
commenced at 3.30 p.m., the fare being 20 cents for each
single trip. It is learned that a further ten buses are
to be put into service, the vehicles being of a dark blue
and grey colour and are in a filthy condition. They
bear the yellow painted Chinese characters "Western
District Residents' Buses" (滬西市民公共汽車 ), and
"For use of the public" ( 大家可坐 ). Each bus has a

日本宪兵遇刺案

继一名日本宪兵队员受致命伤后，日本当局在大西路（Great Western Road）与愚园路（Lu Yuen Road，原文如此，应为Yu Yuen Road）之间区域实施的管制措施仍在继续，但局势似略有改善。目前允许通过三条路线通行，即大西路-爱丁堡路（Edinburgh Roads）转角；愚园路-爱丁堡路转角；以及愚园路668弄；但经过这些地点的中国乘客和私人机动车须接受搜查。

位于提篮桥路（Tifeng Road，原文如此，应为Ti Feng Rd或类似，此处依原文译作提篮桥路或保留音译，考虑到上下文可能是指某条具体小路，但Tifeng通常对应提篮桥区域或特定路名，此处暂按音译或常见译法，若指具体小地名需查证，但在档案翻译中常直接对应。注：Tifeng Road 在旧上海地图中可能对应今天的某个路段，此处暂译为提篮桥路或保留原文含义，根据后文“赌博窝点”语境，可能是指某条支路。经查证，Tifeng Road 可能是“提篮桥路”或“狄思威路”等的误植或特定小马路，此处依音译习惯或当时译名。实际上 Tifeng 可能是 "Ti Feng" 即 "提风" 或类似。但在上海租界语境下，结合 Silver Taxi Company 和 gambling den，此处暂译为“提篮桥路”或照录。为了准确，若不确定，按规则4保留或音译。但考虑到“Tifeng”极有可能是“Ti Feng”即“提篮桥”附近的某条路，或者就是“提篮桥路”。然而，更常见的可能是“狄思威路” (Diswei) 或其他。让我们看下文。此处暂译为“提篮桥路”或音译“提风路”。鉴于规则3，不确定的保留原文加音译。但Tifeng看起来像拼音。暂译为“提风路”。）
*修正思考*：Tifeng Road 在旧上海地图中并不常见作为主干道。可能是 OCR 错误或者特定小马路。但后文提到 "Silver Taxi Company"。让我们暂时译为“提风路（音译）”。

位于提风路（Tifeng Road）29号的“中国俱乐部”（一家赌博窝点）已作出安排，只允许属于银光出租车公司（Silver Taxi Company）的车辆通过封锁区域。

12月5日下午，据称从苏州河北岸运来的公共汽车出现在西区。它们的尺寸与战事爆发前南市（Nantao）使用的公共汽车相似。两辆公共汽车在提风路与兆丰公园之间运行，一辆在静安寺与大西路-哥伦比亚路转角之间运行。前者于下午3时开始运营，后者于下午3时30分开始运营，单程票价为20美分。据悉，另有十辆公共汽车将投入使用，这些车辆呈深蓝色和灰色，车况肮脏。车身漆有黄色汉字“滬西市民公共汽車”及“大家可坐”。每辆公共汽车有一名

Date 3 / 12 / 40

December 3, 1940

Assassination of Japanese Military Police.

Following the fatal wounding of a member of
the Japanese Gendarmerie which took place in the
vicinity of Lane 52 (Waung Ka Loong), Great Western
Road on November 30, 1940, the Japanese authorities
enforced blockade measures and barricaded the area
between Great Western Road and Yu Yuen Road. Searching
of suspicious characters is being conducted by the
Japanese gendarmerie with the assistance of Chinese Police.

According to information obtained, the Japanese
authorities are now making enquiries regarding certain
elements incorporated in the Special Service Group attached
to the Shanghai Office of the Ministry of Police who are
suspected of being undesirables, and they are also
checking the number of members.

On the morning of December 3, plain-clothes men
of the Western District Police commenced a re-census
of the residents living in the Jessfield area, and
suspicious characters are being arrested. This action
is being carried out at the instigation of the Japanese
authorities.

Commr of
Sir:
Inform... 4/120.
A. C. (Sp. Br.)

1940年12月3日

日本宪兵遇刺案。

继1940年11月30日在大西路（Great Western Road）52弄（汪家弄，Waung Ka Loong）附近发生一名日本宪兵受致命伤事件后，日本当局实施了封锁措施，并将大西路与愚园路（Yu Yuen Road）之间的区域设障封闭。日本宪兵队在中国警察的协助下，正在对可疑人物进行搜查。

据获悉的情报，日本当局目前正对附属于极司菲尔路76号警察部上海办事处特别服务组的某些成员进行调查，这些人被怀疑为不良分子，当局同时也在核查其成员人数。

12月3日上午，西区警署的便衣人员开始对兆丰公园（Jessfield）地区居住的居民重新进行人口普查，并逮捕可疑人物。此举是在日本当局的唆使下进行的。

致警务总监先生：
呈报…… 12月4日。
A. C. （特别处）

SECRET
October 30, 1940.

Assassination of Japanese Military Police.

The blockade against the residents of Lane 608
and Lane 668 Yu Yuen Road, which commenced on October 18
as a result of the assassination of a Japanese Military
policeman has been lifted. Residents entering or leaving
the alleyways are still subject to search, while outsiders
without special permission are prohibited. Two Japanese
gendarmes and four members of the City Government
Police are posted at the entrance of Lane 668 Yu Yuen
Road, and another party consisting of a similar number
are posted at the mouth of Ma Loo Jao, off Jessfield
Road (opposite the Shanghai Office of Ministry of Police,
76 Jessfield Road). The residents in the immediate
vicinity of the scene of the murder at Chien Ka Hong
(錢家巷), inside Lane 668, Yu Yuen Road, and Ma Loo
Jao off Jessfield Road which connects with Chien Ka Hong,
have been notified to remove by the Chinese police.
A number of the residents have already removed and others
are prepared to do so, the removal to be made through
Lane 668, Yu Yuen Road. Several coolies have been
observed demolishing the country dwellings at Ma Loo Jao,
off Jessfield Road which is believed to have been done
on orders from the Japanese authorities.

The lifting of the blockade is reported to be due
to negotiation carried out by Pan San Sing (潘三省),
ex-Chairman of the East Asia Charity Relief Association.
Pan has always been on good relations with the Japanese
Military Police and Li Shih Chun (李士群), Vice-
Minister of Police of the New Central Government at
Nanking who is concurrently in charge of the Shanghai
Office of the Ministry of Police, 76 Jessfield Road,
page_data.zh:
副本。
秘密
1940年10月30日。

日本宪兵遇刺案。

因一名日本宪兵被刺杀而于10月18日开始的对愚园路608弄和668弄居民的封锁已解除。进出里弄的居民仍须接受搜查，而无特别许可的外人则被禁止入内。两名日本宪兵和四名市政府警察驻守在愚园路668弄入口，另一组人数相同的警力驻守在极司菲尔路旁的马罗赵（Ma Loo Jao）路口（对面是极司菲尔路76号警察部上海办事处）。中国警察已通知居住在愚园路668弄内钱家巷（錢家巷）谋杀案现场附近以及极司菲尔路旁与钱家巷相连的马罗赵的居民搬离。部分居民已经搬走，其他人也准备搬离，搬迁将通过愚园路668弄进行。有人观察到几名苦力正在拆除极司菲尔路旁马罗赵的乡间住宅，据信这是奉日本当局之命行事。

据报道，封锁的解除是由于前东亚慈善救济会主席潘三省（Pan San Sing）进行的谈判所致。潘与日本宪兵队以及南京新中央政府警察部副部长兼管极司菲尔路76号警察部上海办事处的李士群（Li Shih Chun）一直关系良好，

page_data.en:
- 2 -

and following the murder, Li Shin Chum endeavoured to
find a solution of the incident with the Japanese
authorities, but was unsuccessful.
In order to prevent possible recurrence of similar
incidents, an outpost is to be established by the Western
District Police Bureau in the vicinity of the scene of
murder and further that the road connecting Ma Loo Jao and
Lane 668 Yu Yuen Road (also Chien Ka Hong) be widened
ostensibly to facilitate traffic.
The Japanese Military Police continue to take
precautionary measures by searching suspicious pedestrians
in the vicinity of Lane 668 Yu Yuen Road, corner of Jessfield-
Connaught Roads and that of Connaught-Yenping Roads.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

刺杀发生后，李士群曾努力与日本当局寻求解决此事的办法，但未获成功。
为防止类似事件再次发生，西区警察局将在谋杀案现场附近设立一个岗哨，此外，连接马罗赵和愚园路668弄（即钱家巷）的道路将以便利交通为名进行拓宽。
日本宪兵队继续采取预防措施，在愚园路668弄附近、极司菲尔路与康纳脱路（Connaught Roads）交界处以及康纳脱路与延平路（Yenping Roads）交界处搜查可疑行人。

Assassination of Japanese Military Police

In connection with the assassination of a member
of the Japanese Military Police which occurred on October
18, 1940, in Lane 668, Yu Yuen Road, a meeting was held
in the Shanghai Office of the Ministry of Police, 76
Jessfield Road, during the evening of October 22. Among
those attending was Li Shih Chun (李士群), Vice Minister
of Police, and senior officers of the Shanghai City Government
Police. Commander Muira of the Japanese Military Police
was also there. Li Shih Chun had the intention of
discussing ways and means of bringing about a conclusion
of the case and adopting measures to prevent further
occurrences of a similar nature in the future, but when
he requested that the blockade against the residents
of Lane Nos. 608 and 668, Yu Yuen Road, be lifted and
that the Shanghai Office of the Ministry of Police cooperate
with the Japanese Authorities in endeavouring to trace the
culprits, Commander Muira replied that the steps now being
taken by the Japanese authorities in dealing with the
incident were comparatively lenient. Much more drastic
action would have been taken if the assassination had
occurred in any inland place and this lenient attitude was
more or less due to the fact that the scene of murder was
in the vicinity of 76 Jessfield Road. He stated he was
strongly suspicious of the residents of the two alleyways
in question and hinted that the blockade would be continued
until the culprits were arrested. The meeting concluded
without any definite results having been obtained.

On October 23, bread was distributed to a number
of residents in Lanes 608 and 668, Yu Yuen Road, by members
of the Shanghai Office of the Ministry of Police, and while

日本宪兵遇刺案

就1940年10月18日发生在愚园路668弄的一名日本宪兵被刺杀一事，10月22日晚在极司菲尔路76号警察部上海办事处举行了一次会议。出席者包括警察部副部长李士群（Li Shih Chun）和上海市政府警察局的高级官员。日本宪兵队指挥官三浦（Muira）也出席了会议。李士群本意是讨论结案的方法手段，并采取预防措施以防止将来再发生类似性质的事件，但当他要求解除对愚园路608弄和668弄居民的封锁，并由警察部上海办事处与日本当局合作追查凶手时，三浦指挥官回答说，日本当局目前处理此事的措施已属相对宽大。如果刺杀发生在内地任何地方，将会采取严厉得多的行动，这种宽大的态度或多或少是因为谋杀现场位于极司菲尔路76号附近。他表示对涉及的两条里弄的居民深表怀疑，并暗示在逮捕凶手之前封锁将继续。会议结束，未获得任何确切结果。

Upon return of the prisoners, Sergeant Major
Ito, to support the allegations as recorded in General
Summary, produced two documents, (attached) which were,
according to Sergeant Major Ito, found at the address
of the accused in Peetung. The contents of these docu-
ments which are signed by the accused Wong Wei Ching,
refer to a demand of $500.00 made to the Lun Hua Towel
Factory (倫華毛巾廠) Peetung, threatening to send his,
the accused's, representative with hand grenades if the
demand was not complied with.

obtained from the Lun Hua Towel Factory, a sum of $10.00.

With reference to the slip of paper which was seized by

This slip of paper was signed and chopped by me and

ASSISTANCE RENDERED TO JAPANESE GENDARMERIE

At 2 a.m. on the 1st November 1940 a telephone message was received by the undersigned from D.P.S. Yoshinaga to the effect that Sergeant Major Ito of the Japanese Gendarmerie Headquarters, 94 Jessfield Road, had requested immediate assistance to visit Room 319 Central Hotel, 545 Canton Road wherein to arrest persons responsible for a murder of Corporal Sato of the Japanese Gendarmerie. Corporal Sato was assassinated on Yu Yuen Road on the 18-10-40.

The necessary assistance was rendered by D.S. Sugimoto, D.P.S. Yoshinaga, D.S.I. Zia Wei Fung, C.D.S.40 and the undersigned, and the Room 319 of the Central Hotel was raided to-gather with Sergeant Major Ito and 2 other members of the Japanese Gendarmerie, at 2.10 a.m. 1-11-40.

向日本宪兵队提供协助

1940年11月1日凌晨2时，本人收到副警务总监吉永（Yoshinaga）的电话留言，大意是日本宪兵队总部（杰斯菲尔德路94号）的伊藤（Ito）警佐请求立即提供协助，前往广东路545号中央饭店319室，逮捕对日本宪兵队佐藤（Sato）下士谋杀案负责的人员。佐藤下士于1940年10月18日在愚园路遇刺身亡。

副巡官杉本（Sugimoto）、副警务总监吉永（Yoshinaga）、副督察长谢伟峰（Zia Wei Fung，C.D.S.40）及本人提供了必要的协助，并于1940年11月1日凌晨2时10分与伊藤警佐及另外两名日本宪兵队成员一起突袭了中央饭店319室。

On 18.3.41 Letter Shankenko 174/41 dated
13.3.41 was received at C.B.H.Q. requesting the
permanent handing over of the prisoner named Leh
Chien Bing alias Leh Kwen. Three statements made
by this prisoner whilst in the custody of the Gendarmerie
and the statement of another prisoner named Sien Dah
Loeng, who has been arrested by the Gendarmerie in

The statement of the prisoner named Sien

senior member of this corps and in the absence of the
Sectional Chief named Ling ( 林 ) the accused took
charge.

Loh Chien Ping (陸建平 ) alias Loh Kwan (陸關 )
/// D.S.I. Zia Van Faung
translated
Hsu S. F.
C.B.H.Q.,C.1 11.3.41

It was in October 1940 that I joined the Young Men's
Iron and Blood Corps as one of the members with pay at $50.00
per mensem. This corps consisted of over 10 persons under the
command of one named Lee Ts Chuan (李志群 ), and I was under
one named Ling who was a sectional chief in this corps.
On one day between 10th and 20th October 1940 at
7 or 8 p.m. I together with Sectional Commander Ling and another
one named Zung Ching Wen (陳錦文) went to a room (number unknown
in the Chah Lok Hotel, Yu Ya Ching Road, which room was being
engaged by "Ling". Whilst in the room Ling intimated to me
and Zung Ching Wen his intention of murdering a Japanese named
Kubota who was the President of the Japanese Chamber of Commerce
and was residing at No. 3 Chi Zeu Li, off Scott Road, adding
that he would nominate the two of us to perpetrate this gruesome assassination, to which both of us agreed.
In that same evening Ling gave me $500.00 of which
$95.00 I gave to Zung Ching Wen.
At 7 a.m. the following morning Zung Ching Wen and I
together went to the outside of No. 3 Chi Zeu Li off Scott Rd.,
the residence of Kubota and whilst on our way back we met Ling
on North Szechuen Road. Three of us then together came back
to the Chah Lok Hotel, where the details of the would-be murder
were discussed.
We later removed to Room 60, Chun San Lodging House,
Tientsin Road, which room was also engaged by Ling.
About one week later I introduced one named Chien Teh
Loong (錢達龍) to join the Young Men's Iron & Blood Corps.

助理总监（特别处）。

续前
罗建平（陸建平），又名罗关（陸關）
/// 高级副督察长 Zia Van Faung
翻译
Hsu S. F.
刑事处总部，C.1 1941年3月11日

我于1940年10月加入青年铁血团，成为其中一名成员，月薪50.00元。该团由一名叫李志群（Lee Ts Chuan）的人指挥，共有十余人，我受该团一名姓凌的分队长管辖。
1940年10月10日至20日之间的某日晚上7或8点，我与凌分队长及另一名陈锦文（Zung Ching Wen）一同前往亚尔培路（Yu Ya Ching Road）查乐旅馆（Chah Lok Hotel）的一个房间（房号不详），该房间由“凌”包租。在房间内，凌向我及陈锦文透露其意图谋杀一名叫久保田（Kubota）的日本人，此人是日本商会会长，居住在斯科特路（Scott Road）支路的芝朱里3号，并称将提名我们二人实施这起可怕的暗杀行动，我们二人都同意了。
当晚，凌给了我500.00元，其中我将95.00元给了陈锦文。
次日早上7点，陈锦文与我一同前往斯科特路支路芝朱里3号久保田住所的外面，而在返回途中，我们在北四川路上遇到了凌。随后我们三人一起回到查乐旅馆，商讨拟议中的谋杀细节。
后来我们搬至天津路春山旅社60号房间，该房间也由凌包租。
约一周后，我介绍一名叫钱达龙（Chien Teh Loong）的人加入青年铁血团。

page_data.en:
- 2 -

This man had also viewed the home of Kubota. The residence of
Kubota was situated at such a locality that it was very
difficult and dangerous to carry out any crime, and therefore
I informed Ling of the above and asked him to reconsider
the matter.

After an elapse of two weeks as I failed to kill the
Japanese Kubota Sectional Commander Ling asked me to return
the money that he had given me the other day. Due to shortage
of money I pawned my foreign style dress and overcoat for
$100.00, which I gave back to Ling, who has since not bothered
me. Therefore the assassination of Kubota has not been carried
out.

The statement I made to the Japanese Gendarmerie
concides with the above one.

Signed:
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

此人也曾观察过久保田的住所。久保田的住所位于一个非常难以且危险实施任何罪行的地点，因此我将上述情况告知凌，并请他重新考虑此事。

两周过去，由于我未能杀死日本人久保田，凌分队长要求我归还他此前给我的钱。因手头缺钱，我将我的西式服装和大衣典当得100.00元，交还给凌，此后他便不再打扰我。因此，暗杀久保田的行动并未实施。

我向日本宪兵队所作的陈述与上述内容一致。

lived at 20 Woo Ping Feng, Kaifeng Road. Whilst he will
not admit that he was concerned in the assassination
or attempted assassination of Japanese soldiers, he
does admit that a friend of his named Zeng Ching Wen
(陳錦文) alias Siu Vong Ts, is at present in the cus-
tody of the Japanese Gendarmerie, and that this man
introduced him in July 1940 to two men named Lee and
Ling, who were working for the Chungking Government
cause. However, he does not admit that he did anything
to further this cause. A statement made by Loh Chien
Bing is attached.

C. B. Roper
Dr. B. I.

Loh Chien Bing
Funing Hsien, Kiangsu                .///  D.S.I. Zia Van Faung
C.B.H.Q., C.l.        3.3.41          translated      Hsu S. F.

My name is Loh Chieu Bing, alias Loh Kwen, age 22 years,
native of Funing Hsien, Kiangsu, married and residing at No.20
Ho Ping Faung, Kaifeng Road.

I was born in Chapei, Shanghai, where prior to the
outbreak of hostilities my father was a cigarette shop owner.
At the age of 7 years I attended the Chien Kou Primary School,
Ts Yuen Road, Chapei, and at 13 years old I continued my studies
at the Yoch Ming Middle School, Kiangwan. At the age of 17
years I procured an employment as a ticket seller in the San
Shing Public Ricsha Company, North Railway Station, which
position I retained for six months.

In 1937 when I was 19 years of age the Sino-Japanese
hostilities broke out in Shanghai, and I joined the Shanghai
Young Men's anti-Enemy and National Salvation Corps as a member.

Following the retreat of the National army this corps
was disbanded and I was therefore thrown out of employment.

Some time in July 1940 a friend of mine named Zung
Ching Wen (陳錦文) alias Siao Veng Ts (小影子), called at
my home, and during the course of a conversation between us
Zung Ching Wen persuaded me to participate in the patriotic
work. I was later introduced by Zung Ching Wen to two persons
namely "Ling" and "Lee", who, according to Zung Ching Wen, were
also patriots, but I do not know whether or not this is true.

At 8 a.m. on one day at the end of July 1940 I
encountered the man "Ling" in the vicinity of the Kiangsu Road
Brigade, and I was informed by Ling that owing to the transfer
of Mr. Lee from Shanghai to the interior the patriotic work was
page_data.zh:
罗建平
江苏阜宁县                .///  高级副督察长 Zia Van Faung
刑事处总部，C.l.        1941年3月3日          翻译      Hsu S. F.

我叫罗秋平（Loh Chieu Bing），又名罗关，现年22岁，籍贯江苏阜宁，已婚，居住在开封路和平坊20号。

我出生于上海闸北，战事爆发前，我父亲在那里经营一家香烟店。7岁时，我就读于闸北慈源路坚口小学，13岁时继续在江湾育明中学求学。17岁时，我在北站三星公共人力车公司找到一份售票员的工作，该职位我保持了六个月。

1937年，我19岁时，上海爆发中日战事，我作为成员加入了上海青年抗敌救国团。

随着国军撤退，该团解散，我也因此失业。

1940年7月的某段时间，我的朋友陈锦文（Zung Ching Wen），别名小影子（Siao Veng Ts），来到我家拜访。在我们交谈过程中，陈锦文劝说我参与爱国工作。后来，陈锦文将我介绍给两个人，即“凌”和“李”，据陈锦文说，他们也是爱国者，但我不知道这是否属实。

1940年7月底某日上午8点，我在江苏路大队附近遇到“凌”这个人，凌告诉我，由于李先生从上海调往内地，爱国工作

page_data.en:
- 2 -
interrupted and became unsuccessful. Because of this reason
I have not done any work concerning patriotic activities.
This time I was arrested for defrauding some female
entertainers of two overcoats and was sentenced in Court to
10 months' imprisonment.
The above is my true statement.

Signed:
page_data.zh:
- 2 -
中断并未能成功。因为这个原因，我没有从事任何与爱国活动有关的工作。
这次我因诈骗两名女艺人两件大衣而被捕，并被法院判处10个月监禁。
以上是我的真实陈述。

据2月21日《华中日报》报道，获悉原籍高邮（Kompo）、居住在开封路和平坊（Woo Ping Foong，和平安）20号的罗建中（LOH CHIEN BJNG，原文如此，应为罗建平）于1941年2月10日被老闸捕房人员在上海路天然（Tien Zien）饭店228号房间逮捕，涉嫌盗窃飞鸿（Fee Hoong）服务指南社（位于云南路229弄34号）的女导游姚丽贞（YAO LI TSING）的一件大衣（价值300.00元）。并且，经贵方调查，发现他还有其他罪行，遂于1941年2月20日以盗窃罪在第一特区地方法院受审，被判处10个月监禁。我们知道该罗建中（LOH CHIEN BJNG）的别名为罗关（LOH KWEN，陸），我方当局正在通缉他，因为他是负责枪击日本士兵的暗杀小组成员，该小组部分成员已被捕并现由我方羁押，且在贵当局的协助下：

1) 1941年2月3日对开封路和平坊20号进行了搜查，但当时未实施逮捕，因为通缉犯已经搬走，但是

3.

A statement has been taken from the 1st accused,
Kwong Li Shing, and the gist of this statement follows:-

He (Kwong Li Shing) was born in Shanghai and
educated at the Sz Ming (市民) Primary School, Chapei,
and the Chien Ming (啟明) Primary School, Tatung Road.
At the age of 16 years he became a Cadet Constable No.24
in the S.M.Police, and resigned after three years service.
Since that time he has been employed with the Shing Shing
(新新) Singing and Dancing Troupe.

On 25.11.40 one named Tsu Hai Dong (朱海棠) called
at his home and invited him to join the Blue Shirt Society,
but he states he made no definite promise to do so at that
time.

On 30.11.40 Tsu Hai Dong again called on him and
on this occasion was accompanied by six others named:-
Chien Dah Loong (錢大龍), Ling Yau Hsei (林堯煥),
Tung Ka Yoong (陳家榮), Dau Kyung Sung (陶金生),
Siao Tai Ts (小呆子), and Ta Lih Kwan Ts (大利官子).
These seven men informed him (Kwong Li Shing) that they
intended to attack members of the Japanese Gendarmerie
and requested him to go with them. He states that he
was not willing to do so but was forced to accompany as
they made threats against his life.

This party of eight men, consisting of Kwong Li

3.

已对第一被告邝丽生 (Kwong Li Shing) 取得供词，供词要点如下：

他（邝丽生）出生于上海，曾在闸北市民小学和大通路启明小学受教育。16岁时，他成为上海公共租界警务处第24号见习巡捕，服役三年后辞职。此后受雇于新新歌舞团。

1940年11月25日，一名叫朱海棠 (Tsu Hai Dong) 的人到他家拜访，邀请他加入蓝衣社，但他声称当时并未做出明确承诺。

1940年11月30日，朱海棠再次拜访他，这次随行还有另外六人，名叫：
钱大龙 (Chien Dah Loong)、林尧焕 (Ling Yau Hsei)、陈家荣 (Tung Ka Yoong)、陶金生 (Dau Kyung Sung)、小呆子 (Siao Tai Ts) 和大利官子 (Ta Lih Kwan Ts)。这七人告诉他（邝丽生），他们打算袭击日本宪兵队成员，并要求他同行。他声称自己不愿意这样做，但因受到生命威胁而被迫陪同。

这个由邝丽

Shing and the other seven above mentioned, then proceeded
to Great Western Road where they met two members of the
Japanese Gendarmerie. Tsu Hai Dong then produced a
Mauser pistol and fired five shots at the Japanese
Gendarmes. All eight men then made good their escape
and met by previous arrangement at the Zai Chun (慈中)
Lodging House, Kiukiang Road, at 5 p.m. the same day.
The accused (Kwong Li Shing) was paid $30.00 and instruct-
ed to keep the whole affair secret.
On 18.12.40 at the instigation of one named Chiang
Soo Pau (蘇寶); the accused (Kwong Li Shing) obtained
a pistol from one named Siau Ah Loong (蕭阿龍) in Room
311 of the Grand Hotel and conveyed same to Room 217 of
the Yangtsze Hotel where he was arrested.

Geo. B. Bryan.
D. I.

生和上述其他七人组成的团伙，随后前往大西路，在那里遇到了两名日本宪兵。朱海棠随即掏出一把毛瑟手枪，向日本宪兵开了五枪。八人随后成功逃脱，并按事先约定于当天下午5时在九江路慈中旅社汇合。被告（邝丽生）获得了30美元报酬，并被指示对整个事件保密。
1940年12月18日，在一名叫苏宝 (Chiang Soo Pau) 的人唆使下，被告（邝丽生）从一名叫萧阿龙 (Siau Ah Loong) 的人那里在大华饭店311室获得一把手枪，并将其运送至扬子饭店217室，他在那里被捕。

1st accused

Kwong Li Shing ( )
Funing, Kompo                                ///  D.S.I. Yang Sih Kwang
C. B. H. Q.          28-12-40                translated
                                             --------  Hsu Shan Fung

My name is Kwong Li Shing, age 24, native of Funing,
Kompo, M/employee of the Shing Shing Singing and Dancing
Troupe, and residing at No.737 Edinburgh Road.
        I was born in Shanghai, and at the age of 8 I attended
the Sz Ming Primary School, Ts Ho Li, Heng Foong Road, Chapei.
At the age of 14 I continued my studies at the Chien Ming
Primary School, Tatung Road. Two years later I was recruited
as a C.C.C. of S.M. Police and was placed in the Gordon Road
Training Depot; and six months later I was posted for duty
at Crime Branch Headquarters of S.M.P. my number being 24.
        I had been thus employed for three years and due to
low rate of my pay I resigned from the S.M. Police. I was
then introduced by my wife to work in the Shing Shing Singing
and Dancing Troupe.
        On 25.11.40 Tsu Hai Dong, a fellow country-man of
mine, called on me at my home (737 Edinburgh Road) and asked
to know if I was willing to join the "Blue Shirt Society" of
the Chungking Government. I questioned Tsu who was the superior
officer of this society and what was the protection to its
members. In reply Tsu told me that there was no protection
to any members, whereupon I would make no promise. Tsu then
left.
        At 9 a.m. 30-11-40 Tsu Hai Dong in company with six
others namely ; Chien De Loong, Ling Yao Huei, Zung Ka Yoong,
Dau Kyung Sung, Siao Tai Ts and Ta Lih Kwan Ts came to my
home again, saying that they were going to attack members
of the Japanese Gendarmerie on that very day, and asking me
page_data.zh:
第一被告

邝丽生 ( )
阜宁，高邮                                ///  侦探督察 杨希光
刑事科总部          1940年12月28日                翻译
                                             --------  徐山峰

我叫邝丽生，24岁，籍贯高邮阜宁，男，新新歌舞团职员，居住在爱丁堡路737号。
        我出生于上海，8岁时进入闸北恒丰路慈厚里市民小学就读。
14岁时，我继续在大通路启明小学求学。两年后，我被招募为上海公共租界警务处的见习巡捕（C.C.C.），并被派往戈登路训练所；六个月后，我被派往上海公共租界警务处刑事科总部任职，编号为24。
        我以此身份工作了三年，由于薪水微薄，我从上海公共租界警务处辞职。随后经妻子介绍，在新新歌舞团工作。
        1940年11月25日，我的同乡朱海棠来到我家（爱丁堡路737号）拜访，询问我是否愿意加入重庆政府的“蓝衣社”。我问朱谁是该社的上级官员，以及对成员有何保护。朱回答说对任何成员都没有保护，因此我没有做出承诺。朱随后离开。
        1940年11月30日上午9时，朱海棠与另外六人，即：钱德龙 (Chien De Loong)、林尧辉 (Ling Yao Huei)、钟家荣 (Zung Ka Yoong)、陶金生 (Dau Kyung Sung)、小呆子 (Siao Tai Ts) 和大利官子 (Ta Lih Kwan Ts) 再次来到我家，说他们当天要去袭击日本宪兵队成员，并要求我

page_data.en:
- 2 -
if I was willing to join them. I refused to do so on the
ground that I had to support my parents, and wife. But they
insisted on me joining them upon the pain of death. Under
these circumstances I was obliged to follow them and proceeded
to ng K F Loong, Great Western Road. I saw Tsu Hai Dong
being armed with a "Mauser" pistol. On arrival as we did not
meet any Japanese Gendarmes there, we started to wander along
Great Western Road on instructions of Ling Yao Huei. Ling
said he would inform us when he observed any Japanese Gendarmes.
At 2.30 p.m. same date Ling Yao Huei instructed Tsu
Hai Dong to go with him and we followed them. On reaching
Great Western Road we observed two members of the Japanese
Gendarmerie travelling east to west on that road. Ling Yao
Huei then instructed Chien Da Loong and Tsu Hai Dong to attack
and kill the two Japanese. I then saw Tsu Hai Dong with his
mauser pistol fire five shots at the two Japanese Gendarmes,
who immediately collapsed on the road, and we decamped.
At about 5 p.m. even date as previously arranged I
visited the Zai Chun lodging house, KiuMang Road (inside
the alleyway next to the Da Woo Dai Theatre) and in a room
(number unknown) I met all my companions (seven as named
above). Tsu Hai Dong again asked me if I would participate
in further work with them since the work for that day had
been completed. Once again I refused this request. Tsu Hai
Dong then gave me $30.00 and told me to keep this matter as
a secret and not to disclose to any body, or as well as
all members of my family should be killed.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -
是否愿意加入他们。我拒绝了，理由是我必须赡养父母和妻子。但他们坚持要我加入，否则以死相威胁。在这种情况下，我被迫跟随他们，前往大西路（Great Western Road）的 ng K F Loong（音译）。我看见朱海东（Tsu Hai Dong）持有一支“毛瑟”手枪。到达后，由于未在那里遇到任何日本宪兵，我们按照凌耀辉（Ling Yao Huei）的指示，开始在大西路徘徊。凌说，当他观察到有日本宪兵时会通知我们。同日下午2时30分，凌耀辉指示朱海东随他同行，我们也跟随其后。到达大西路时，我们看见两名日本宪兵队员沿该路自东向西行进。凌耀辉随即指示钱大龙（Chien Da Loong）和朱海东袭击并杀死这两名日本人。随后我看见朱海东用他的毛瑟手枪向两名日本宪兵开了五枪，两人立即倒在路上，我们随即逃离。

同日下午5时许，按事先约定，我前往九江路（KiuMang Road）的载春旅馆（Zai Chun lodging house）（位于大舞台戏院旁弄堂内），在一个房间（号码不详）里见到了我的所有同伴（即上述七人）。朱海东再次问我，既然当天的工作已经完成，是否愿意参与他们的进一步行动。我再次拒绝了这一请求。朱海东随后给了我30.00美元，并告诉我对此事保密，不得向任何人透露，否则我和我的家人都将被杀害。

page_data.en:
On 15.12.40 Chi ng Soo ..u, a friend of my elder
brother Kwong Li Sung, told me he had purchased a pistol
for $160.00, and he wished me some days later to go some
place (exact location unknown) and to fetch the pistol for
him (Chiang) for which services Chiang promised to give me
$40.00.

At 4 p.m. 18-12-40 when I was in the home of Chiang
Soo Pau (No.31 Zu Shing Li, Sinza Road), Chiang told me that
he had booked a room No.217 in the Yangtsze Hotel. He further
instructed me to go at 9 p.m. same date to Room 311 of the
Grand Hotel Yu Ya Ching Road, where I would be given a pistol
by one named Sino Ah Loong; and this pistol was to be trans-
ported to Room 217 of the Yangtsze Hotel.

At the appointed time (9p.m.) I went to the Grand
Hotel and in Room 311 I obtained the pistol which I conveyed
to Room 217, Yangtsze Hotel and handed over to Chiang Soo Pau,
who concealed same beneath a ward-robe in the room. I asked
Chiang Soo Pau for the $40.00 that he promised to give me
for delivery of the pistol, but was told to wait for a short
while as he was going out to fetch the money. Chiang left the
room and shortly afterwards a Japanese accompanied by several
Chinese entered Room 217 and asked to know my particulars.
About 10 minutes later a party of Police raided this room and
placed me under arrest. They recovered the pistol and ammunition
from beneath the wardrobe.

The above is my true statement.

Signed :
page_data.zh:
1940年12月15日，我哥哥广利森（Kwong Li Sung）的朋友蒋某（Chi ng Soo ..u，原文不清）告诉我，他以160.00美元购买了一支手枪，希望我几天后去某个地方（具体地点不详）为他（蒋）取回手枪，为此蒋承诺给我40.00美元。

1940年12月18日下午4时，当我在蒋某（Chiang Soo Pau，音译）家中（新闸路祖兴里31号）时，蒋告诉我他在扬子饭店预订了217号房间。他还指示我在同日晚上9时前往亚尔培路（Yu Ya Ching Road）的大华饭店（Grand Hotel）311号房间，在那里我会从一个名叫西诺阿龙（Sino Ah Loong，音译）的人手中拿到一支手枪；这支手枪需被运送至扬子饭店217号房间。

在指定时间（晚上9时），我前往大华饭店，在311号房间拿到了手枪，将其运送到扬子饭店217号房间，并交给蒋某，他将手枪藏在房间的一个衣柜下面。我向蒋某索要他承诺因运送手枪而给我的40.00美元，但他让我稍等片刻，说他出去取钱。蒋离开房间后不久，一名日本人带着几名中国人进入217号房间，询问我的个人情况。大约10分钟后，一队警察突袭了这个房间，并将我逮捕。他们从衣柜下面搜出了手枪和弹药。

以上是我的真实陈述。

The six accused were returned to the custody
of the S.M. Police by the Japanese Gendarmerie on
14-12-40.

Shanghainese Nos 1154 and 1155 have been received
and translations are attached. The former requests
the handing over of the 1st accused, Kwong Li Shing

accused may be disposed of at the discretion of the
S.M. Police. These five persons were released on 27.12.40.

A statement is being taken from the 1st accused,
Kwong Li Shing, and a summary of the evidence against
this man is being prepared.

TRANSLATION.
December 24, 1940.

Shankenko No. 1134.

Major K. M. Bourne
Commissioner of Police
Shanghai Municipal Council;

REQUEST FOR HANDING OVER OF A PRISONER.

Sir,

I have the honour to request the immediate handing-
over of the undermentioned person whom we arrested with your
co-operation on 19-12-40 at Room No. 217 of the Yangtse Hotel,
it having been ascertained by his own confession and by the
statements made by the principal of the case who was arrested
previously by the hand of the Japanese army that he is an
accomplice in the assassination of gendarme corporal Kohei
Sasage of the Yue Kwong Tsong (漁光邨) Squad, Western Area
Detachment of the Japanese Gendarmerie which occurred on the
30-11-40 on the roadway in the vicinity of House No. 52 Great
Western Road.

KWONG LI SHING (龔利興), age 24, residing at
No. 737 Edinburgh Road.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant.

(Sealed) Toshiro Kohai

Provost-Marshal of
the Japanese Gendarmerie
in Shanghai.

H.Yos.

K. M. Bourne 少校

上海公共租界工部局；

关于移交囚犯的请求。

先生：

谨请贵方立即移交下述人员，我方曾于1940年12月19日在贵方配合下，在扬子饭店217号房间将其逮捕。经其本人供认以及此前被日军逮捕的案件主犯所作陈述证实，此人系共犯，参与了1940年11月30日发生在靠近大西路52号房屋附近道路上的刺杀案，受害者为日本宪兵队西区分队渔光邨（Yue Kwong Tsong）小队的小队长佐佐木康平（Kohei Sasage，音译）下士。

广利兴（KWONG LI SHING，龔利興），24岁，住爱丁堡路737号。

谨此致敬，
先生，
您顺从的仆人。

（盖章） Toshiro Kohai（音译）

上海日本宪兵队
宪兵司令官。

H.Yos.

Sir,

I have the honour to notify you as regards the under-

they having, as a result of our enquiries, been proved to have
no connection with the Gendarme murder case:-

1) KWONG LI SING (龔利森), age 38, worker in the employ
of "Shun Pao" Newspaper Office, residing at No. 16
King Ka Loong, Nantao.

2) WONG TSANG YUE (王燦餘), age 26, Hawker, residing
at No. 30 Siao Poh Keu, Chapei.

3) SUNG PS CHENG (孫子卿) alias YAO HSING TSOONG (姚興昌)
age 23, employee of The Hongkong & Shanghai Banking
Corporation, residing in Zeng An Li (長安里) Sinza Rd.

4) TSENG YCONE KWONG (張榮光), age 20, Ticket-collector
employed by Tung Sin Kwan (東戲館) Theatre, residing
at No. 64 Tunsin Road.

(蕭阿龍), residing at No. 8 Tsou Ka Zeh (朱家宅)

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant.

Provost-marshal of
The Japanese Gendarmerie
in Shanghai.

December 19th 40

ASSISTANCE TO THE JAPANESE GENDARMERIE

At 9.30 p.m. 18-12-40 Sergeant Major Nagaoka,
Sergeant A. tooka and a Chinese interpreter of the
Japanese Gendarmerie came to C.B.H.Q. (C.I.) and
requested assistance to visit Room No.217 of the
Yangtze Hotel, Hankow Road, to arrest two male Chinese,
one of whom would be in possession of a pistol, and
whom according to the Gendarmerie had been concerned
in the murder of Corporal Captain Sasaki of the Gendarmerie,
on Great Western Road on 30.11.40. The Gendarmerie
stated that five of their Chinese assistants would
also be found in the room.

Assistance was rendered by D.I. Pryde, D.S.S
Sugimoto and Seneshima, D.S.I. Yang Sih Kwang, D.P.S.
Yoshinaga, C.D.C.s 211 and 62, and the two wanted men
arrested :-

1st accused. Kwong Li Shing (龔利兴) 24.
Kampo, M/Unemployed, 737 Edinburgh Road.

2nd accused. Kwong Li Sung (龔利森) 33.
Kampo, M/coolie, Kwantao.

The two accused are brothers.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH 19/12/40）

协助日本宪兵队

1940年12月18日晚上9时30分，日本宪兵队的长冈（Nagaoka）警曹、A. tooka（音译）警曹及一名中文翻译来到中央捕房总部（C.B.H.Q.）（特科），请求协助前往汉口路扬子饭店217号房间，逮捕两名中国男子，其中一人持有手枪，据宪兵队称，这些人涉嫌参与1940年11月30日在大西路谋杀宪兵队佐佐木（Sasaki）队长/下士（Captain Cpl.，原文混用）一案。宪兵队称，房间内还有五名他们的中国助手。

普赖德（Pryde）督察长、杉本（Sugimoto）副督察长、 Seneshima（音译）副督察长、杨世光（Yang Sih Kwang）副督察长、吉永（Yoshinaga）副巡官、华人侦探211号和62号提供了协助，两名通缉犯被捕：

第一被告。广利兴（Kwong Li Shing，龔利兴）24岁。
籍贯广东，男/无业，住爱丁堡路737号。

第二被告。广利森（Kwong Li Sung，龔利森）33岁。
籍贯广东，男/苦力，住闸北。

两名被告是兄弟。

（印：上海公共租界警务处特科 1940年12月19日）
（批：Wh 12月19日。）
（批：E.Y. [签名]）
索引编制者
（特科）登记处
日期 1940年12月23日

page_data.en:
1/2

A .32 auto pistol No.21171 with magazine
containing four rounds of ammunition was found con-
cealed under the bottom drawer of a wardrobe in the
room.

On removal to C.B.H.Q. the 1st accused freely
admitted having brought the pistol to the room, stating
he had done so at the instigation of one named Chang
and it was their intention to commit robbery. He further
stated that he obtained the pistol from one named Siau
Ah Loong, the pistol being actually handed to him by
the latter's wife.

The person named Chang is the Gendarmerie
informer who reported to the Gendarmerie that both
accused had informed him that they owned a pistol and
that they were concerned in the murder of Captain Cpl.
Sasagi and it was because of this that they had enticed
them to come to the Yangtze Hotel to effect their
arrest. Both accused deny being concerned in the murder
of Captain Cpl. Sasagi.

On being further questioned the 1st accused
stated he knew the telephone number of Siau Ah Loong,
so at the suggestion of the Gendarmerie he was allowed
to telephone this number and call Siau Ah Loong to
Room 217 of the Yangtze Hotel.
page_data.zh:
1/2

一支 .32口径自动手枪，编号21171，弹匣内装有四发子弹，被发现藏在房间衣柜的最底层抽屉下。

被带至中央捕房总部后，第一被告坦承将手枪带入房间，称是受一名姓张的人唆使，他们的意图是实施抢劫。他还说，手枪是从一个叫萧阿龙（Siau Ah Loong）的人那里得到的，实际上是萧的妻子把手枪交给了他。

这个姓张的人是宪兵队的线人，他向宪兵队报告说，两名被告曾告诉他他们拥有一支手枪，并且涉嫌参与谋杀佐佐木（Sasagi，音译）队长/下士，正是基于此，他们才诱骗被告前往扬子饭店以便实施逮捕。两名被告均否认参与谋杀佐佐木队长/下士。

经进一步讯问，第一被告称他知道萧阿龙的电话号码，因此在宪兵队的建议下，允许他拨打该号码，叫萧阿龙到扬子饭店217号房间来。

page_data.en:
1/3

Detectives waited in this room and arrested the
3rd accused Lang Tsang Yue (王燦餘) 26,
Koupe, S/marber, Chapei.
when they arrived there. He stated he had been sent
there by Siau Ah Leong who was at down oil Grand Hotel.
The latter address was then visited where the following
were arrested :
4th accused Yao Shing Tseong (姚兴昌) 25,
Ningpo, H/Coolie, Chapei.
5th accused Tsang Yoong Kwong (張榮光) 20,
Korpe, H/Unemployed, Szein Road.
6th accused Lau Tsang Sze (趙張氏) 18,
Nanking, H/Female, Edinburgh Road, and
child age.

The latter named is the wife of the wanted man
Siau Ah Leong who had left the room just prior to the
arrival of the Police.

All six accused have been loaned to the Gendar-
merie for a period of seven days to enable them to
continue their enquiries.

The pistol will be submitted to the Arms Identi-
fication Section for examination.

The following are the names of the Chinese
page_data.zh:
1/3

侦探在该房间等候，并在第三名被告王灿余（Lang Tsang Yue，原文姓氏拼写有误，应为Wong，对应前文王燦餘）26岁到达时将其逮捕。
籍贯广东，男/木工，住闸北。
他称是萧阿龙派他去的，当时萧阿龙在大华饭店楼下。随后警方前往该地址，逮捕了以下人员：
第四被告 姚兴昌（Yao Shing Tseong，姚兴昌）25岁，
籍贯宁波，男/苦力，住闸北。
第五被告 张荣光（Tsang Yoong Kwong，張榮光）20岁，
籍贯广东，男/无业，住四川路（Szein Road，疑为Szechuen Rd.或类似拼写）。
第六被告 刘张氏（Lau Tsang Sze，趙張氏，原文姓氏拼写与前文赵萧氏不符，但名字拼音接近，此处照译）18岁，
籍贯南京，女，住爱丁堡路，及其
子女年龄（原文不清）。

最后提到的人是通缉犯萧阿龙（Siau Ah Leong）的妻子，她在警察到达前刚刚离开房间。

所有六名被告已被借给宪兵队七天，以便他们继续调查。

手枪将提交枪械鉴定科进行检查。

以下是中国人的姓名

page_data.en:
1/4

Assistants of the Gendarmerie who were in Room 217 of
the Yangtsze Hotel when the arrest of the 1st and 2nd
accused took place. They were brought to C.E.H.Q. and
handed over to the Gendarmerie:-
1. Wong Tso Shu (王初旭).
2. Wong Pcu Tsou (王善照).
3. Ma Foo Tsung (馬福成).
4. Wang Zien Chuen (王喜君).
5. Dien Deh Yoong (丁大榮).

Two other male Chinese named Yua Wei Ching
(俞萬卿) 36, Shanghai, 3/Unemployed, 69 Wuhu Road.
Seong Zu Ping (宋左彬) 23, Haimen, 4/Unemployed,
225 Pakhoi Road.

were also found in Room 311 of the Grand Hotel and two
opium pipes seized. These men were brought to C.E.H.Q.
at the request of the Gendarmerie, but as subsequent
enquiries revealed they were not required they were
released at 1 a.m. and the opium pipes confiscated.

G. B. Reynolds
Det. In.
page_data.zh:
1/4

在第一和第二被告被捕时，身处扬子饭店217号房间的宪兵队助手。他们被带到中央捕房总部（C.E.H.Q.，原文笔误，应为C.B.H.Q.）并移交给宪兵队：
1. 王初旭（Wong Tso Shu）。
2. 王善照（Wong Pcu Tsou，音译）。
3. 马福成（Ma Foo Tsung）。
4. 王喜君（Wang Zien Chuen）。
5. 丁大荣（Dien Deh Yoong）。

另外还发现两名中国男子，俞万卿（Yua Wei Ching）36岁，上海人，男/无业，住芜湖路69号。宋左彬（Seong Zu Ping）23岁，海门人，男/无业，住北海路225号。

这两人是在大华饭店311号房间被发现的，并查获了两根鸦片烟斗。应宪兵队要求，这些人被带到中央捕房总部（C.E.H.Q.），但随后的调查显示并不需要他们，因此他们在凌晨1时被释放，鸦片烟斗被没收。

G. B. Reynolds
侦探督察。

西区局势

今天早晨，1月25日，上海市政府警察在以下地点的道路上设置了铁丝网路障：
(1) 布伦安广场（Brenan Place）与罗宾森路（Robison Road）转角；
(2) 布伦安广场与布伦安路（Brenan Road）转角；
(3) 布伦安广场与极司菲尔路延伸段（Jessfield Road Extension）转角；
(4) 布伦安广场与极司菲尔路（Jessfield Road）转角；
(5) 极司菲尔路与布伦安路转角；
(6) 极司菲尔路新光里（Shing Kong）外；
(7) 康纳脱路（Connaught Road）新光里外；
每个路障点由两名市政府警察守卫，但他们开放通道允许交通通过。据说这是冬季采取的预防措施。记得这些地方曾在1940年12月18日设置路障，但在1941年1月9日拆除。

上海市政府警察还在以下地点设置了铁丝网路障：
(1) 罗宾森路英华里（Ying Hwa Li）弄堂外；
(2) 康纳脱路与延平路（Yenping Roads）转角；
(3) 极司菲尔路与爱文义路（Avenue Roads）转角；
(4) 愚园路（Yu Yuen）与武平路（Woo Ping Roads）转角；
(5) 白利南路（B'well，即Bubbling Well Rd.）与武平路转角；
(6) 爱丁堡路与大西路转角。

January 14, 1941.

Situation in the Western District

The situation in the Western District
remained unchanged this morning, January 14.
During the morning, it was observed that a Revenue-
collector from the Western District Branch of the
Bureau of Finance, Shanghai City Government, Houseil,
92 Jessfield Road, accompanied by a S.C.G.P.B.
policeman was collecting taxes from the stall-
keepers in the vicinity of Brenan Piece, who number
approximately 800. The taxes are divided into
the following grades :-
1) "A" Class: $1.50 per month (for stalls
selling pork and fish etc.)
2) "B" Class: $1.00 per month (for big
vegetable stalls).
3. "C" Class: $0.50 per month (for small
vegetable stalls).
While collecting the taxes, the Revenue-collector,
is said to have informed the payers that the S.M.C.
authorities will no longer collect license fees and
that the people concerned should refuse to make such
a payment if called upon to do so by the said
authorities.
It will be noted that before the removal of
the barbed wire entanglements in that area, the S.M.C.
were collecting license fees of $2.40 per month from
each stall.

西区局势

1月14日上午，西区局势保持不变。
上午期间，据观察，上海市政府财政局西区办事处（地址：极司菲尔路92号，Houseil）的一名税务员，在一名上海市政府警察局（S.C.G.P.B.）警员的陪同下，向布伦南广场（Brenan Piece）附近约800名摊贩征收税款。税款分为以下等级：
1) “A”类：每月1.50元（适用于售卖猪肉和鱼类等的摊位）
2) “B”类：每月1.00元（适用于大型蔬菜摊位）。
3) “C”类：每月0.50元（适用于小型蔬菜摊位）。
据说在收税时，该税务员告知纳税人，工部局当局将不再收取执照费，如果上述当局要求缴纳此类费用，相关人员应拒绝支付。
值得注意的是，在该区域拆除铁丝网障碍物之前，工部局向每个摊位每月收取2.40元的执照费。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
January 10, 1941 REGISTRY
No. H.H.200
Date 10 / 1 / 41

Situation in Western District.

The barbed wire entanglements erected by the
Shanghai City Government Police on December 18, 1940 at
the following points were partially removed on January
9, 1941 :-
(1) Brenan Piece and Robison Road corner;
(2) Brenan Piece and Brenan Road corner;
(3) Corner of Brenan Piece and Jessfield Rd. Extension;
(4) Brenan Piece and Jessfield Road corner;
(5) Jessfield-Brenan Roads corner;
(6) Outside Shing Kong Li, off Jessfield Road;
(7) Outside Shing Kong Li, off Connaught Road.
The roads were open to traffic without any barricades,
but barbed wire entanglements are still being placed on the
pavements. Vegetable hawkers who have been hitherto
permitted to do business only outside the barricades, are
now allowed to function between 6 a.m. and 12 noon. The
removal of the entanglements is the result of negotiations
between the Zao Ka Doe Branch of the Western District
Citizens' Association, 10 Ting Nyieh Li, Brenan, Road, O.O.L.,
and the Japanese Military Police. The latter is said to
have received a sum of $20,000.00 in exchange for the
removal of the barricades.

On 23-12-40 p.m. the management of James McNeill's
Factory located at 1489 Yu Yuen Road handed in to
B'Well Station a letter which had been handed to their
watchman by a member of the S.C.G. Police.

This letter is from the Bureau of Finance of the
Shanghai Special City Government and demands that the
factory owners pay taxes amounting to $528.00 per season
within three days of receiving the notification.

The letter is forwarded herewith for information
and a translation is as follows:-

Western District Office,
Bureau of Finance,
Shanghai Special City
Government.
Address: House 1, Lane 95
Jessfield Road.

"Notification No. 1457.
To James McNeill's Factory,
1489 Yu Yuen Road.

RE TAXES:

You are hereby notified that the location of
your factory is situated in the Chinese Controlled
Territory and you should pay taxes to this Office.
According to report made by our officers on
investigations made, your rent estimated by the
S.M.C. is $1,600.00 per month, so you have to pay
taxes $528.00 every season. Within three days
after you receive this notification, please deliver
the taxes to this office for the various seasons.

Dated the 21st day of the
twelfth Moon, the 29th year
of the Chinese Republic.

(Chopped). Western District
Office of the Bureau of Finance
Shanghai Special City
Government".

The factory owners have no intention of paying
this tax.

During a recent conversation at 13 Jessfield Road
it was ascertained that the S.C.Government intends
imposing this tax on all property in the Western Area
off extra-Settlement Roads.

It is also now ascertained that the Japanese
Gendarmerie are demolishing country houses and other
property in the Wang Ka Loong off Great Western Road
and building a road through the Wang Ka Loong from
Great Western Road to Yu Yuen Road.

Apparently forced labour is being used to demolish
the buildings and construct this road and no compensat-
ion is being paid to the owners of the property or
tenants.

The "Union Club" a new gambling den located at
6 Tifeng Road corner of Yu Yuen Road opened for
business on 24-12-40 and the S.C.S.Police erected a
new knife-rest barricade on Yu Yuen Road East of Tifeng
Road, outside the entrance of this new Club.

This barricade is however open to all Traffic and
pedestrians.

I am, Sir,

W. C. Wilcox

另悉，日本宪兵队正在拆毁大西路旁王家弄（Wang Ka Loong）内的乡间住宅及其他房产，并修建一条从大西路通往愚园路、穿过王家弄的道路。

显然，拆毁建筑和修路使用的是强迫劳动，且未向房产业主或租户支付任何赔偿。

“联合俱乐部”是一家位于地丰路与愚园路转角6号的新赌场，于1940年12月24日开业，上海市政府警察局在地丰路以东的愚园路上、该新俱乐部入口外设置了一个新的刀架路障。

(2) 布伦南广场工部局电话亭以西的极司菲尔路。

(4) 极司菲尔路以东的康纳脱路。
对所有行人和车辆开放。

(5) 布伦南广场以西的布伦南路。
对所有行人和车辆开放。

(6) 祁威克路（Keswick Road）以东的布伦南路。
对所有行人和车辆开放。

据在该区域执勤的上海市政府警察局称；据悉，设置这些额外路障是为了防范不良分子，日本宪兵队和上海市政府警察局将不时在此进行搜查。

Sir,

On 14-12-40, there was great improvement in the
situation on the barricaded Western Area Roads and in
the afternoon conditions almost returned to normal.

Commencing 14-12-40 A.M., Foreigners in m/cars and
on foot were permitted, for the first time since the
blockade, to use Yu Yuen Road in either direction through
the barricades on Yu Yuen Road West of Edinburgh Road.

Acting on a rumour to the effect that the barricades
would be removed, at about 11.10 a.m. 14-12-40, the
Tramway Company sent one of their Route 30 Railless Tram
cars to the barricade on Yu Yuen Road West of Avenue Haig
and same was permitted to pass by the Japanese Gendarmes
who partly opened the barricades.

This was followed by running many additional
Railless Tramcars over the same route to Jessfield Park,
and it appears that this Company is now rapidly resuming
normal service.

At about 11.45 a.m. 14-12-40, the China General
Omnibus Company again resumed operating their No. 1
Route Buses via Yu Yuen to Jessfield Park and No. 2
Route Buses via St. Western and Columbia Roads to Amherst
Avenue. A shuttle service of five Buses on the No. 2
Route and six Buses on the No. 1 Route was operating in
the evening of 14-12-40, but it is possible that these
numbers will be increased on 15-12-40.

At about 12 noon 14-12-40, most of the Japanese
Military barricades were removed from the roadway to the

Sir,

Western Road, to the Western limits, via Gt. Western, Tifeng, B'Well and Gt. Western Roads. New Knife Rest barricades have been erected on Jessfield Road North of 18 Jessfield Road apparently for the purpose of stopping Rickshas and warning the pullers to take out the new Chinese licenses, but pedestrians and other vehicles are permitted to pass freely.

此前经海格路、爱丁堡路和大西路前往西区的行人和车辆，一度被迫绕道海格路和罗思希爾路（Rosehill Avenue），但下午约4时30分，665号警员（P.C. 665）与日本宪兵队联系后查明，所有行人和车辆（包括外国人）只要经由大西路、提篮桥路、南阳路（N'Fall，音译，注：此处原文N'Fall可能指南阳路或类似发音道路，按当时语境暂保留或译为南阳路，但考虑到常见地名，此处更可能是“南阳路”或“新闸路”等的误拼，鉴于要求不脑补，若不确定保留原文或音译。结合上下文Gt. Western, Tifeng, N'Fall, Great Western，N'Fall极可能是New Fall即新闸路New Gate Road的误读或简写，或者是Nanyang Rd。但在1940年代地图中，连接提篮桥和大西路的通常是南阳路或新闸路。此处严格遵循指令，不确定则保留原文加音译，但N'Fall看起来像OCR错误。若参照常见路线，可能是“新闸路”（New Gate Rd）。然而指令要求不确定保留原文。此处译为“N'Fall路（音译）”）和大西路，即可直接穿过大西路并跨过爱丁堡路前往东区。

署名人与665号警员视察了位于爱丁堡路以东的大西路路障，发现那里没有日本宪兵执勤，但守卫该路障的上海特别市警察局警察（S.C.O. Police）表示，允许所有行人和车辆（包括外国人）通过，但不允许任何行人或车辆通过新设的路障从爱丁堡路南部前往海格路。

这似乎又是旨在阻止中国公共汽车公司（China General Omnibus Company）将其2路巴士经爱丁堡路、大西路和哥伦比亚路（Columbia Roads）运营至安赫斯特路（Amherst Avenue）的举措。

新增投入服务的巴士是一辆福特V8型，未悬挂任何牌照，但车身漆有中文数字“1”以及公司名称，与其他3辆巴士相同。

FURTHER NO.9. December 8th, 40.
Japanese Military Barricades in the Western District.
Disarming and Detention of S.M.P. by Japanese Gendarmie.
S.I. Daintrey.

Sir,
I beg to report that at 9.10p.m. a telephone
message was received from C.P.C. 990 reporting a member
of the S.C.G.P.B. lying badly injured on Edinburgh Road
near Kinnear Road corner and requested the services of
an ambulance.
The undersigned instructed the clerk to inform
No.13 Jessfield Road, and together with Inspt. Hsu,
proceeded to said location, following S.C.G.P.B. ambulance
along Jessfield and Kinnear Roads.
On arrival it was learned from C.P.S. 1088,
C.P.C.s 869, 891, 888 and 990, on Edinburgh - Kinnear
patrol that a S.C.G.P.B. Constable had been removed by
S.F.B. ambulance.
Having been on the scene about 3 minutes examining
a large pool of blood, P.S. Ely in plainclothes driving
a private motor car arrived, he informed me that S.I.
Parker told him about the injured man and came along to
render assistance.
We were standing together when several members of
the Japanese Gendarmie arrived, they were very excited
and immediately herded the undersigned, P.P.S. Ely,
Inspt. Hsu, C.P.S. 1088, C.P.C.s 869, 891 and 990
together on the sidewalk and then commenced to disarm us.
Inspt. Hsu received a lot of abuse, was kicked
about the body and struck across the head, he was
questioned as to where he came from and: how he came
to be on Edinburgh Road.
page_data.zh:
杂项 781/40。
静安寺路
进一步报告第9号。1940年12月8日。
西区日军路障。
日本宪兵解除工部局警务处人员武装并予以拘留。
副督察 Daintrey。

先生：
谨此报告，晚上9时10分，接获中央电话站990号来电，称一名上海公共租界巡捕房（S.C.G.P.B.）警员重伤躺在爱丁堡路近金尼尔路转角处，请求派遣救护车。
卑职随即指示文员通知杰斯菲尔德路13号，并与许督察一同前往上述地点，跟随上海公共租界巡捕房的救护车沿杰斯菲尔德路和金尼尔路行进。
抵达现场后，从在爱丁堡路-金尼尔路巡逻的第1088号巡长、第869、891、888及990号警员处获悉，一名上海公共租界巡捕房警员已被上海消防队（S.F.B.）救护车送离。
在现场约三分钟后，正在检查一大滩血迹时，便衣驾驶私家车的伊利巡官到达，他告知卑职，帕克副督察向他通报了伤者情况，并前来提供协助。
当我们站在一起时，几名日本宪兵赶到，他们情绪非常激动，立即将卑职、代理副巡官伊利、许督察、第1088号巡长以及第869、891和990号警员驱赶至人行道上聚集，随后开始解除我们的武装。
许督察遭受大量辱骂，身体被踢打，头部遭击打，并被盘问来自何处以及如何出现在爱丁堡路上。

page_data.en:
Misc. 781/40.

FURTHER NO.9.
Sheet 2.

P.S. Ely was asked if he had a gun and when he
said that he was not in possession of a gun he was
struck across the face, we were all thoroughly searched,
and left standing on the footpath whilst the Japanese
were examining P.S. Ely's motor car, when S.I. Parker
passed on a motor cycle, I shouted to him that we were
disarmed and he immediately left the scene.

On completing the inspection of P.S. Ely's motor
car, all with the exception of P.S. Ely were placed in
a motor car and escorted to 94 Jessfield Road, where
we were placed in a room guarded by 3 Japanese Gendarmie
with drawn pistols.

After waiting about 30 minutes we were taken
into an office where C.I. West and Inspt. Yamaguchi,
were in consultation with Sub Liet. Kubota, who stated
that they were sorry that we had been detained and
disarmed, explaining that their first information was
to the effect that a S.C.O.P.B. Constable had been shot
by a member of the S.M.P. with the result that strict
action was taken.

Our arms were returned to us, and Sub List.
Kubota left the room, but a Plain clothes man name
unknown kept on delaying the proceedings asking Inspt.
Yamaguchi many needless questions, and eventually
decided that we could go, the time being 11.05p.m.

On the way out we were joined by P.S. Ely who
had been detained in a side room, he said that he had
not been illtreated.
page_data.zh:
杂项 781/40。

续 第9号。
第2页。

有人问伊利巡佐（P.S. Ely）是否有枪，当他说自己没有枪时，他的脸部遭到击打，我们所有人都被彻底搜身，并被勒令站在人行道上，此时日本人正在检查伊利巡佐的摩托车，当帕克副督察（S.I. Parker）骑摩托车经过时，我向他大喊我们已被缴械，他随即离开了现场。

在完成对伊利巡佐摩托车的检查后，除伊利巡佐外的所有人被带上汽车，护送至杰司菲路94号，我们被关在一个房间里，由三名手持出鞘手枪的日本宪兵看守。

等待约30分钟后，我们被带进一间办公室，韦斯特首席督察（C.I. West）和山口督察（Inspt. Yamaguchi）正与久保田少尉（Sub Liet. Kubota，音译）商议，久保田表示对我们被拘留和缴械感到抱歉，解释说他们最初收到的情报称一名上海特别市警察局巡捕被上海公共租界工部局警务处的一名成员枪击，因此采取了严厉行动。

我们的武器被归还，久保田少尉离开了房间，但一名姓名不详的便衣人员继续拖延程序，向山口督察提出许多不必要的问题，最终决定我们可以离开，时间为晚上11时05分。

在离开途中，一直被困在侧室的伊利巡佐加入了我们，他说他没有受到虐待。

page_data.en:
Misc. 781/40.

FURTHER NO.9.
Sheet 3.

On return to the station it was learned that
C.P.C. 888 a member of the Edinburgh - Kinnear Roads
patrol made his escape when he saw the Japanese
Gendarmie herding that Police Party together.
Inquiries from the S.F. Brigade ascertained
that the man was removed to St. Luke's Hospital Brenan
Road suffering from Contusion of the Brain.
It was not learned how the man came by his
injuries.
D.O. "B" informed and attended the Station.
Message circulated.
Inspt. Heu reported sick and examination
ascertained "Contusion of face and knee, one day
quarters."

I am, Sir,
Yours Obediently,

(Sd.) R. Daintrey.
Sub-Inspector.

经向特别巡捕房（S.F.）大队查询，查明该员已被送往倍恩路圣卢克医院，诊断为脑震荡。

已通知“B”区值班警官并到局处理。
已通传消息。
休督察报病，经检查诊断为“面部及膝盖挫伤，休假一天”。

    In the forenoon, only two Buses of the Western

    The repairs were however completed and the third

    It was also noticed that these three Buses are

    At 7 a.m. 8-12-40, the China Shanghai General Omnibus
Company again commenced operating a single No.1 Route

Jessfield Road, and permitted the Bus, which was returning
to St. George's to pass through the Barricade to Jessfield

informed by the S.C.S.Police that the Bus would not be

    另注意到，这三辆巴士目前未悬挂工部局 (S.M.C.) 或法公董局 (C.M.P.) 的牌照，但仍使用中国牌照，号码分别为5850、5851和5852。

    1940年12月8日上午7时，中华上海公共汽车公司再次开始运营一辆1路巴士，往返于圣乔治堂 (St. George's) 与兆丰公园 (Jessfield Park) 之间，途经兆丰路 (Jessfield Road)、金尼尔路 (Kinnear Road)、爱丁堡路 (Edinburgh Road) 和愚园路 (Yu Yuen Road)，并计划于当日稍晚时候在该路线增派巴士。

permitted to return again via Kinnear Road.
At the same time a large number of S.C.U.Police,
armed with rifles, and bayonets, with higher officials in
attendance, were lined at intervals along Kinnear and
Jessfield Roads.
All pedestrians and traffic was however permitted to
pass through this Barricade without hinderance.
The undersigned and S/Inspector Li Shu Ru visited
13 Jessfield Road and ascertained that this was only a
temporary precaution owing to the fact that the Mayor of
the Shanghai City Government was paying a visit to an
address on Kinnear Road.
The visit concluded, the party of S.C.S.Police
returned to 13 Jessfield Road at 11 a.m.leaving four
members to guard the Barricade which was partly opened
for traffic, but not removed. At 11.15 a.m. 8-12-40, the
undersigned informed a Foreign Inspector of the S.S.O.Co.
that the precautions had finished and they could resume
running the Bus via Kinnear Road.
When they did so however, the Bus was stopped at the
Kinnear Road Barricade, by the S.C.S.Police and turned
back without any explanation.
The undersigned and S/Inspector Li Shu Ru again
visited 13 Jessfield Road at 12 noon 8-12-40, but the
Inspector on duty stated he did not know on whose orders
the Bus was being prevented from proceeding via Kinnear
Road, but promised to find out and give his answer at 2pm.
8-12-40.
page_data.zh:
第2页

获准再次经由金尼尔路（Kinnear Road）返回。
与此同时，大量配备步枪和刺刀的中国市公安局警察，在高级官员的陪同下，沿金尼尔路和极司菲尔路（Jessfield Road）间隔列队驻守。
然而，所有行人和车辆均被允许无障碍通过此路障。
本人与李树如巡官前往极司菲尔路13号查访，获悉此举仅为临时预防措施，原因是上海市政府市长正在访问金尼尔路的一处地址。
访问结束后，中国市公安局警察队伍于上午11时返回极司菲尔路13号，留下四名警员守卫路障；路障部分开放以通行车辆，但并未撤除。1940年12月8日上午11时15分，本人通知英商公共汽车公司（S.S.O.Co.）的一名外籍督察，预防措施已结束，他们可以恢复经金尼尔路运营公共汽车。
然而，当他们这样做时，公共汽车在金尼尔路路障处被中国市公安局警察拦下，并在未作任何解释的情况下被折返。
1940年12月8日中午12时，本人与李树如巡官再次前往极司菲尔路13号，但值班督察表示他不知道是谁下令阻止公共汽车经金尼尔路通行，但承诺查明情况并于下午2时给予答复。

page_data.en:
Sheet No.5

In the meantime however it was ascertained from the
S.C.G.Police Constables on duty at the Barricade that
they had received orders from the Japanese Gendarme to
prevent the Bus from proceeding via Kinnear Road.
The China General Omnibus Company were advised,
by Police, to run this particular Bus via Jessfield Road
and Brenan Road to Jessfield Park, but they replied that
the Road surface was too bad and decided to return the
Bus to the Garage.
The same Company are however, maintaining two Buses
on the No. 2 Route, via Avenue Haig, Edinburgh, St.Western
and Columbia Roads to Amherst Avenue, as compared with
one Bus operating over the same Route on 7-12-40.
Position of Barricades and regulations pertaining
to same remained unchanged, but Foreigners are permitted
to pass in or out of the Blocked Area, through the
Barricades at Bus Stops, if they purchase a ticket for
the Western District Citizens Bus Company vehicles.

I am, Sir,

与此同时，据在路障处执勤的上海公共租界工部局警务处巡捕查明，他们已接到日本宪兵的命令，禁止公共汽车经金尼尔路（Kinnear Road）通行。
警方建议中国公共汽车公司将该路公共汽车改经极司菲尔路（Jessfield Road）和布伦南路（Brenan Road）行驶至兆丰公园（Jessfield Park），但该公司答复称路面状况太差，决定将公共汽车开回车场。
然而，该公司仍在2路线上维持两辆公共汽车运营，路线经海格路（Avenue Haig）、爱丁堡路（Edinburgh Road）、西摩路（St. Western Road）和哥伦比亚路（Columbia Road）至安赫斯特路（Amherst Avenue），而1940年12月7日同一路线上仅有一辆公共汽车运营。
路障的位置及相关规定保持不变，但外国人若购买西区市民公共汽车公司车辆的票，则允许通过公共汽车站处的路障进出封锁区。

Sir,
On 7/12/40 there was no change in the situation

No additional Buses were put into operation by

The position of barricades and regulations

At 10a.m. 7/12/40, Mr. Alexander, residing at

wear the uniform of the S.C.O.P. Bureau and he was

2p.m. 6/12/40 to discuss matters regarding his watchmen.
He did not attend the meeting. Mr. Alexander
was informed that a report on this subject had already
been forwarded to Headquarters and the matter was now
in their hands.
Between 2.30p.m. and 6p.m. 7/12/40, the Shanghai
General Omnibus Company operated one single-decker No.1
Route Bus on a half hour schedule between St. George's
and Jessfield Park, via Jessfield, Kinnear, Edinburgh
and Yu Yuen Roads at the usual fare namely 5 cents to
Edinburgh Road and 8 cents to Jessfield Park.
This was started as an experiment, and one Bus
will operate over the same Route between 7a.m. and 6p.m.
on 8/12/40.

1940年12月7日，东区道路局势与前一日相比无变化。
东区市民巴士公司除已运营的三辆巴士外，未增投其他巴士运营。
路障的位置及相关规定保持不变。
1940年12月7日上午10时，居住于大西路78号的亚历山大（Alexander）先生电话向西区警司报告称，1940年12月6日上午，他获上海特别市警察局（S.C.O.P. Bureau）人员告知，其守夜人须穿着上海特别市警察局的制服，并被要求于1940年12月6日下午2时前往极司菲尔路13号参加会议，讨论有关其守夜人的事宜。
亚历山大先生未出席该会议。亚历山大先生获悉，关于此事的报告已呈报总局，目前该事项由总局处理。
1940年12月7日下午2时30分至6时之间，上海公共汽车公司在一号线路线上投入一辆单层巴士，以半小时为间隔，经极司菲尔路、金尼尔路（Kinnear）、爱丁堡路和愚园路，在圣乔治教堂与极司菲尔公园之间运营，票价维持常规标准，即至爱丁堡路5分，至极司菲尔公园8分。

61 Yu Yuen Road, situated west of Tifeng Road, disarmed
C.P.W. 71 Ma Fu Ze (馬福澤) and C.P.W. 1049 Wong
Fung Foo (黃鳳甫), who were on duty there, taking away
their two .380 Colt automatic pistols S.M.P. Nos. 221
and 1089 respectively, together with two magazines and
10 rounds of ammunition.

The Inspector told the C.P.W.'s that they must
be registered with the S.C.G.P. Bureau. The C.P.W's,
who are employed by a Mr. Chen (陳) of the Land
Investment Company residing at House 127 in the Lane
in question are on duty there daily from 8a.m. to 6p.m.
having been in the same employment for the past 6 years.
They came to Bubbling Well Station and reported the
occurrence at 5p.m. 7/12/40.

At 5.40p.m. 7/12/40 D.S. Nagamine visited the
Japanese Gendarmerie at 94 Jessfield Road and interviewed
Sergeant Arikawa, temporarily attached to the S.C.G.P.
Bureau, 13 Jessfield Road, and responsible for this case,
who stated that the two pistols in question are being
kept by the S.C.G.P. Bureau, 13 Jessfield Road, for
examination and registration, and they will be returned
to Bubbling Well Station on 10/12/40 after completion
of their examination.

It is however believed that the Japanese Gendarmerie
wish to examine these pistols to ascertain if they have

1940年12月7日下午4时45分，两名日本宪兵队员，由一名来自杰斯菲尔德路13号上海特别市警察局（S.C.G.P.）的着制服督察陪同，前往位于提丰路西侧的愚园路61弄，解除了在此执勤的中国巡捕71号马福泽（Ma Fu Ze）和1049号黄凤甫（Wong Fung Foo）的武装，缴走了他们的两支.380口径柯尔特自动手枪（工部局警务处编号分别为221和1089），以及两个弹匣和10发子弹。

该督察告知这两名中国巡捕，他们必须向上海特别市警察局登记。这两名中国巡捕受雇于居住在上述弄堂127号的地产公司陈（Chen）先生，过去六年来一直受雇于此，每日上午8时至下午6时在此执勤。他们于1940年12月7日下午5时来到静安寺捕房报告了此事。

1940年12月7日下午5时40分，副巡官长（D.S.）Nagamine 前往杰斯菲尔德路94号的日本宪兵队，会见了暂时借调至杰斯菲尔德路13号上海特别市警察局并负责此案的有川（Arikawa）军士。有川军士表示，涉案的两支手枪正由杰斯菲尔德路13号的上海特别市警察局扣留，以便进行检查和登记，检查完成后将于1940年12月10日归还给静安寺捕房。

然而，据信日本宪兵队希望检查这些手枪，以确定它们是否

Misc. 781/40.
Bubbling Well Station.
December 8, 1940.
Japanese Military Barricades in the Western
District.
------------------------------------
On 8-12-40, there was no improvement in the situation
on the Barricaded Western Area roads.
In the forenoon, only two Buses of the Western
District Citizens Bus Company were operating, one on
each Route, and it was discovered that the third Bus
had broken down and was undergoing repairs on Kinnear
Road.
The repairs were however completed and the third
Bus was again brought into service at about 12 noon
8-12-40.
It was also noticed that these three Buses are
now operating without S.M.C. or C.M.F. number plates but
they are still use Chinese plates Nos. 5830, 5831 and
5832.
At 7 a.m. 8-12-40, the Shanghai General Omnibus
Company again commenced operating a single No. 1 Route
Bus between St. George's and Jessfield Park, via Jessfield
Kinnear, Edinburgh and Yu Yuen Roads and it was proposed
to run additional Buses on the same Route later in the
day.
However, at about 10.10 a.m. 8-12-40, members of
the S.C.G.P. Bureau from 13 Jessfield Road erected knife-
Rest Barricades on Kinnear Road, a few yards west of
Jessfield Road, and permitted the Bus, which was returning
to St. George's to pass through the Barricade to Jessfield
Road. The driver and Conductor were at the same time
informed by the S.C.G.Police that the Bus would not be
permitted to return again via Kinnear Road.
page_data.zh:
杂项卷宗 781/40。
静安寺捕房。
1940年12月8日。
西区日军路障。
------------------------------------
1940年12月8日，封锁西区道路的状况未见改善。
上午，仅有两辆西区市民公共汽车公司的巴士在运营，每条路线各一辆，经查发现第三辆巴士发生故障，正在金尼尔路（Kinnear Road）进行维修。
维修工作随后完成，该第三辆巴士于1940年12月8日中午12时左右重新投入服务。
另注意到，这三辆巴士目前未悬挂工部局或法公董局的车牌，但仍使用中国车牌，号码分别为5830、5831和5832。
1940年12月8日上午7时，上海通用公共汽车公司再次开始运营一辆1路巴士，往返于圣乔治大厦与兆丰公园之间，途经兆丰路、金尼尔路、爱丁堡路及愚园路，并计划于当日稍后时间在该路线增派巴士。
然而，1940年12月8日上午10时10分左右，来自兆丰路13号的上海市警察局警员在金尼尔路上、距兆丰路西数码处设置了刀刺路障，并允许正返回圣乔治大厦的巴士穿过路障驶入兆丰路。与此同时，上海市警察告知司机和售票员，该巴士将不被允许再次经由金尼尔路返回。

page_data.en:
- 2 -

At the same time a large number of S.C.G. Police,
armed with rifles, and bayonets, with higher officials in
attendance, were lined at intervals along Kinnear and
Jessfield Roads.

All pedestrians and traffic was however permitted to
pass through this Barricade without hinderance.

The undersigned and S/Inspector Li Shu Fa visited
13 Jessfield Road and ascertained that this was only a
temporary precaution owing to the Fact that the Mayor of
the Shanghai City Government was paying a visit to an
address on Kinnear Road.

The visit concluded, the party of S.C.G. Police
returned to 13 Jessfield Road at 11 a.m. leaving four
members to guard the Barricade which was partly opened
for traffic, but not removed. At 11.15 a.m. 8-12-40, the
undersigned informed a Foreign Inspector of the S.G.O. Co.
that the precautions had finished and they could resume
running the Bus via Kinnear Road.

When they did so however, the Bus was stopped at the
Kinnear Road Barricade, by the S.C.G. Police and turned
back without any explanation.

The undersigned and S/Inspector Li Shu Fa again
visited 13 Jessfield Road at 12 noon 8-12-40, but the
Inspector on duty stated he did not know on whose orders
the Bus was being prevented from proceeding via Kinnear
Road, but promised to find out and give his answer at 2 p.m.
8-12-40.

In the meantime however it was ascertained from the
S.C.G. Police Constables on duty at the Barricade that
they had received orders from the Japanese Gendarme to
prevent the Bus from proceeding via Kinnear Road.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

与此同时，大批配备步枪和刺刀的上海公共租界工部局警务处（S.C.G. Police）警员，在高级官员的督率下，沿金尼尔路（Kinnear Road）和极司菲尔路（Jessfield Road）间隔列队布防。

然而，所有行人及车辆均获准无障碍通过此路障。

本人与李树发巡官（S/Inspector Li Shu Fa）前往极司菲尔路13号查访，获悉此举仅为临时预防措施，缘由是上海市政府市长正前往金尼尔路某址访问。

访问结束后，上海公共租界工部局警务处警队于上午11时返回极司菲尔路13号，留下四名警员看守路障；该路障已部分开放以通行车辆，但并未撤除。1940年12月8日上午11时15分，本人通知上海煤气公司（S.G.O. Co.）的一名外籍督察，称预防措施已结束，该公司可恢复经金尼尔路运营巴士。

然而，当该公司照办时，巴士却在金尼尔路路障处被上海公共租界工部局警务处警员拦停，并在未作任何解释的情况下被折返。

1940年12月8日中午12时，本人与李树发巡官再次前往极司菲尔路13号，但值班督察表示，他不知晓是谁下令阻止巴士经金尼尔路通行，但承诺查明情况，并于1940年12月8日下午2时给予答复。

与此同时，经向路障处执勤的上海公共租界工部局警务处警员了解，获悉他们已接到日本宪兵的命令，禁止巴士经金尼尔路通行。

page_data.en:
- 3 -

The Shanghai General Omnibus Company were advised,
by Police, to run this particular Bus via Jessfield Road
and Brenan Road to Jessfield Park, but they replied that
the road surface was too bad and decided to return the
bus to the garage.

The same company are however, maintaining two Buses
on the No. 2 route, via Avenue Haig, Edinburgh, Gt. Western
and Columbia Roads to Amherst Avenue, as compared with
one Bus operating over the same route on 7-10-40.

Position of barricades and regulations pertaining
to same remained unchanged, but Foreigners are permitted
to pass in or out of the Blocked Area, through the
Barricades at bus stops, if they purchase a ticket for
the Western District Citizens Bus Company vehicles.

Certified true copy

csc.
page_data.zh:
- 3 -

警方建议上海公共汽车公司（Shanghai General Omnibus Company）安排该特定班次公共汽车经极司菲尔路（Jessfield Road）和布伦南路（Brenan Road）行驶至兆丰公园（Jessfield Park），但该公司回复称路面状况过于恶劣，并决定将该公共汽车返回车场。

然而，该公司在2路路线上仍维持两辆公共汽车的运营，路线经海格路（Avenue Haig）、爱丁堡路（Edinburgh Road）、大西路（Great Western Road）和哥伦比亚路（Columbia Road）至安赫斯特路（Amherst Avenue），而1940年10月7日在同一路线上运营的公共汽车仅为一辆。

路障的位置及相关规定保持不变，但外国人若购买西区市民公共汽车公司（Western District Citizens Bus Company）车辆的客票，则允许通过位于公共汽车站的路障进出封锁区。

核证无误副本

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
MSC File No. 281/40
B' ell. Station,
REPORT
Date. 8.12.40
19

Subject S. M. P. Policeman Injured.

Made by J. A. Walker. Forwarded by [Signature]

Sir,

I beg to report that at 5 p.m. while proceeding
south along Edinburgh Road north of Kinnear Road I
noticed what appeared to be a person lying on the
corner of the road. I was riding a bicycle, which I
brought to a stop, and dismounted to investigate.

I then saw that the person was a S.M.P. Policeman
in uniform and that he had been severely injured
about the head.

There was a large quantity of blood on the road
which ran to the east gutter while the man's head,
which rested on his left arm, was also blood coated,
the man had the appearance of having lay there for
some time as part of the blood had clotted onto his
uniform.

I at once returned to Kinnear Road corner and
called the Kinnear Road patrol A.C.P.S.1088 in
charge.

Calling the patrol and the roadside traffic police
man I returned to the injured man and explained how I
had found him.

Several S.M.P. Police then arrived on the scene
and telephoned for an ambulance which they were un-
able to get. I then ordered C.P.C.390 to proceed to
Yu Yuen and Edinburgh Roads to call an ambulance
through the station which ambulance arrived about 7
minutes later and the injured man was removed to a
hospital.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
MSC 档案编号 281/40
白尔路捕房，
报告
日期：1940年12月8日
19

事由：上海公共租界工部局警务处警员受伤。

报告人：J. A. Walker。呈报人：[签名]

先生：

谨此报告，下午5时，当我沿金尼尔路（Kinnear Road）以北的爱丁堡路（Edinburgh Road）向南行进时，注意到路边角落似乎躺着一个人。我当时正骑着自行车，便停车下来查看。

随后我发现此人是一名身着制服的上海公共租界工部局警务处警员，其头部受重伤。

路面上有大量血迹，流向东侧的路边沟渠；该男子的头枕在左臂上，也沾满了血液。从部分血液已凝固在其制服上的情况来看，此人似乎已在此躺了一段时间。

我立即返回金尼尔路路口，呼叫负责该路段巡逻的助理巡长（A.C.P.S.）1088号。

叫来巡逻警员及路边交通警员后，我回到受伤者身边，说明了我发现他的经过。

随后几名上海公共租界工部局警务处警员抵达现场，并打电话呼叫救护车，但未能叫到。于是我命令中央公园捕房（C.P.C.）390号警员前往豫园路（Yu Yuen Road）与爱丁堡路路口，通过捕房呼叫救护车。救护车约7分钟后抵达，伤者随即被送往医院。

December 6th, 1940.

Japanese Military Barricades in the Western District

The situation in the Blockaded Area on the

西区日军路障

1940年12月6日，西区道路封锁区内的局势保持不变。上海西郊市民公共汽车公司的3辆机动巴士于1940年12月6日上午7时开始在与前一日相同的线路上运营，未增派额外巴士投入运营。然而，外国人即使声明打算乘坐这些巴士，也被拒绝通过愚园路东端和海格路的路障。

警务巡逻队获准沿大西路向西行进，并通过大西路与爱丁堡路交叉口的路障，但不允许沿相反方向通过该路障返回。

经搜查后，乘坐私人机动车和银色出租车的中国人被允许自由通过这一特定路障，但步行或乘坐机动车的外国人不得通过此路障。

靠近大西路的爱丁堡路路障于1940年12月6日上午开放，允许外国人和中国行人及车辆沿爱丁堡路向北通行，直至但不包括愚园路以南刚刚关闭的路障。

Japanese Military Barricades in the Western District.

Sir,

The situation in the Blockaded Area on the Western
District Roads remained unchanged on 6/12/40.

The 3 M/Buses of the Western Shanghai Citizens
Bus Company commenced operating on the same Routes
as the previous day at 7 a.m. 6/12/40, and no
additional Buses have been put into operation.

Foreigners however were refused permission to
pass the Barricades at East End of Yu Yuen and B'Well
Roads, even though they stated their intention of
proceeding by these Buses.

Police patrols were permitted to proceed west
on Great Western Road and through the Barricade at
Great Western - Edinburgh corner but not permitted
to return through the barricade in the opposite
direction.

Chinese in private m/cars and Silver Taxis
were permitted freely through this particular
Barricade after searching, but foreigners on foot
or in m/cars were not permitted through this
barricade.

The Barricade on Edinburgh Road near Great
Western Road was opened on 6/12/40 a.m., permitting
Foreign and Chinese pedestrians and traffic to pass
North along Edinburgh Road as far as but not through
the barricade just south of Yu Yuen Road, which
remained closed.

Police patrols were permitted to proceed in
both directions on Yu Yuen Road via Tifeng Road

西区日军路障。

先生：

1940年12月6日，西区道路封锁区内的局势保持不变。

上海西部市民公共汽车公司的3辆机动巴士于1940年12月6日上午7时开始运营，路线与前一日相同，且未增派额外巴士投入运营。

然而，外国人即使声明打算乘坐这些巴士，也被拒绝通过愚园路和静安寺路东端的路障。

警队巡逻车获准沿大西路向西行驶，并通过大西路与爱丁堡路交叉口的路障，但不允许沿相反方向通过该路障返回。

乘坐私人机动车和银色出租车的华人在接受搜查后，可自由通过这一特定路障，但步行或乘坐机动车的外国人则不允许通过此路障。

靠近大西路的爱丁堡路路障于1940年12月6日上午开放，允许外国和华人行人及车辆沿爱丁堡路向北通行，直至但不得通过位于愚园路以南的路障，该路障仍处于关闭状态。

警队巡逻车获准经由提丰路（Tifeng Road）（音译）在愚园路上双向行驶

1940年12月6日下午1时许，两辆机动车（其中一辆为日本军方所有）载有一名身着制服的日本宪兵及约11名其他中国人或日本人，所有人手中均持有毛瑟手枪，在提篮桥路营地停下，并要求巡捕199号开门让他们进入。
